Asylum, 1901; asst. med. offr., Seychelles, Aug., 1901; J.P. and chmn. of loc. bd. of health, 1st and 2nd diva., South Mahe; med. supt., lunatic asylum, Seychelles, Mar., 1906; ch. med. offr., 1924.

BRADSTREET, FREDERICK GEORGE.—B. 1884; ent. C.A.'s office, June, 1902; asst. head, checking and insurance dept., May, 1919; do., gen. dept., Jan., 1924; sec., Zambesi Edje. Interdept. comtee., 1928-31; dep. head, finance dept., Mar., 1931; dep. head, gen. dept. and dep. ch. clk., 1933; head, appts. and passages dept., 1935.

BRADY, Lieut.-Col. JOHN BANKS, D.S.O.—Head mast., Grey Coll. Sch., Dec., 1901; inspr. of schls., O.R.C., Feb., 1904; inspr. of schls., Rhodesia, Aug., 1909; on active serv., 1914-20; commanded 4th and 18th batts. K.R.R.C.; ment. in desps.; croix de guerre with palm leaves; ag. dir. of educ., S. Rhodesia, 1920-21.

BRAGG, ALGERNON.—B. 1890; col. audit dept., Apr., 1915; asst. audr., Nigeria, May, 1915; mily. audit, E. African Expedy. Force, 1916-19; asst. audr., Uganda, 9th May, 1919; senr. asst. audr., Uganda, Sept., 1924; ag. audr., Uganda, for various periods, 1926-27; prin. asst. audr., Nov., 1928; ag. audr., May
1900 and 1901; ch. just., Br. Guiana, 1902; ret., 1912.

BOVELL-JONES, Lionel Clifford.—B., 1897; ed. Christ's Hosp.; enlisted 1915; served in France, Feb., 1916-Aug., 1918; demob., 1919; sub inspr., pol., British Guiana, July, 1920; dist. inspr., 1924; offr.-in-ch., punitive expd., to Venezuelan bindy., 1925; passed colloquial Hindi exam., 1927; county inspr., 1931.

BOWEN, F. C. P.—B., 1896; copyist, audit dept., B. Honduras, 1912, also depts. of col. sec. and regis.-gen.; 3rd cls. clk., atty.-gen.'s off., 1915; 2nd cls. clk., ditto, 1918; clk. to regis.-gen., 1919; secy., riot inquiry comsn., 1919; ag. regis.-gen. and cust. enemy ppty. and contr., L.C.O., 1920; secy., yellow fever inquiry comsn., 1921; ag. regis.-gen., 1921, 1923 and 1925; regis.-gen., regis., lands titles, sup't., vice-adm'y. and bankcy. cts., companies, patents, births, marriages and deaths, 1927; J.P.; stamp comsnr., dir., pub. offr. guarantee fund; comsnr., income tax, 1927; sec. in arbitrn. between govt. of U.S.A. and Guatemala, 1930; dist. comsnr., Belize, offr., recr. in bankruptcy, offr., admstr., estates, coroner, 1933; ag. asst. col. sec., 1934; postmr. (in addn.), 1935.

BOWER, Sir Graham John, K.C.M.G. (1892), C.M.G. (1886).—B., 1848; ret. comdr., R.N.; entered navy, 1861, and served on Mediterranean; E. coast of Africa, E. Indian, Home, and Australian stations, until 1880, when he was apptd. priv. sec. to Sir Hercules Robinson, gov. Cape of Good Hope, and high comsnr. for S. Africa; imperial sec. to the high comsnr., 1884-97; colonial sec., Mauritius, 1898; admtnl. gov't. on various occasions, 1900-09; ret. 1910.

BOWERLEY, Walter, C.B.E., (1931), B.A., St. John's Coll., Camb. (class. tripods, 1899); apptd. clk., col. audt branch of E. and A. Dept., Nov., 1901; asst. audr., S. Nigeria, Sept., 1902; ag. asst. treas., Oct., 1902; ag. local audr. in 1903, 1904, 1905 and of amalgamated territories, Lagos—S. Nigeria, 1906-7; ag. local audr., N. Nigeria, Nov., 1907, to Mar., 1908; local audr., Gambia, Apr., 1908; local audr., G. Coast, Nov., 1909; title changed to audr., 1910.

BOWMAN, Humphrey Ernest, C.M.G. (1936), C.B.E. (1918).—B., 1879; ed. Eton and New Coll., Oxford (2nd cls. mod. hist. 1902); B.A., 1902; M.A., 1906; ent. Egyptian miny. of educn., 1903; seconded to Sudan govt. (dept. of educn.), 1911-13; dir., Egyptian students in U.K., 1913-14; serv. with Br. Army, 1914-20; B.E.F., France, 1915-16; staff capt., H.Q., N. Command, 1916-18; India, 1918; Mesopotamia, 1918-20; ret. with rank of major, 1920; seconded from M.E.F. as dir. of educn., Mesopotamia, 1918-20; seconded to govt. of Palestine, 1920-23; dir. of educn., Palestine, 1920; mem., advisory coun. since 1920; chmn., comsn. on crafts and industries, 1922; mem., transliteration comte., 1923; chmn., comte., transliteration of geographical names, 1924; chmn., bd. of higher studies.

BOWRING, Archibald George.—Ed. Nottingham High Schl. and Nottingham Univ. Coll.; capt., Sherwood Foresters, 1914-19; miny. of lab., Nov., 1919 to Nov., 1920; col. audt. dept., Nov., 1920; asst. audr., Nigeria, Jan., 1921; do., Sierra Leone, Mar., 1930; ag. audr., May to June, 1930.

BOWRING, Sir Charles Calvert, K.C.M.G. (1925), K.B.E. (1919), C.M.G. (1908).—Ed. at Clifton Coll.; col. audt. branch of exchequer and audit dept., 1890; Hong Kong, Dec., 1892; loc. aud., B. C. Africa, Sept., 1895; East Africa Prot. and Uganda irr., 1896; treas., E. A. P., Ock., 1901; mem., reg. co-op. soc., E. A. P., A., 1907; ch. mem., reg. co-op. soc., E. A. P., Apr., 1911; ag. gent., 1912; Aug. to Oct., 1913; ag. gent., 1914; Aug. to Oct., 1915; ag. gent., 1916; Aug. to Oct., 1917; ag. gent., 1918; Aug. to Oct., 1919; and from Nov., 1919; gen., Maid. 1923-1924.

BOWRING, Hon. Sir Basil K.C.M.G. (1934), Kt.Bach. (1935).—Mem. legis. coun., Newfoundland; comsnr. for Newfoundland in London, 1933.

BOWYER, Eric Blacklock.—B., Whitechill Sch., and Glasgow Univ. spec. ship., 1920; B.Sc. (with distinction), 1922; Clarke schol., 1923; M.A. (lat. cls. honours nat. philos.), 1924; ast. ing., 1925; app. to C.O. as ast. prin. after exam., 8th Nov., 1926; joint sec., 1927; comte., 1927; seconded for serv. with development comte., 1st Oct., 1930; partly, under-secr. of State for Ind. (Mr. Lunii), 22nd June, 1931; do. (Mr. MacDonald), 3rd Sept., 1931; prin. 6th Mar.

BOWYER, John Herbert, M.B. (Dub.), D.P.H. (Trin. Coll., Ireland)—med. and health offr., S.S., Apr., 1925; offr., S'pore., Oct., 1930; do., Klang, 1931; ag. dy. state med. and heal. Solangon, Feb., 1935.

BOYCE, E.A., B.Sc. (Edin.)—B. engr., P.W.D., Uganda Prot., 1925; engr. in charge Mbulu dist., 1925; Prov., 1927; dep. D.P.W., Bahamas, ag. D.P.W. in 1930, 1932 and 1933; Br. Honduras, 1936.

BOYD, Edmund Blaikie, C.M.G. (1894); ed. Aberdeen Gram. Sch., Univ. of Aberdeen; M.A. 1916; hon. classics; on military service with 60th siege batt., R.G.A., France, Belgium, Nov., 1917, to June, 1919; 2nd Oct., 1917; lieut., Apr., 1919; temporary C.O., Sept., 1919; apptd. by cir. ser. under reconstr. scheme, 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 1920; asst. prim., 1st Apr., 1921; perm. under-secr., May to Sept., 1921; sec. dept. comte., income tax in col., 1922; sec. partly, under-secr. (Mr. Wood, now vis. Halifax), 4th Apr., 1922; (Mr. Ormby) Oct., 1922; sec. Imp. Inst. comte., of 1923; priv. sec. to Lord Arnold, 26th Jan.; ag. prin., 12th Dec., 1924; priv. 2nd Nov.; sec., C.O. comte., 1927; sec., col. develop. advisory comte., 1929; pvt. sec. to Lord Pas., as S. of S. for Doms. affs. and for the Col., Apr., 1930; pty. sec. to succesive sec. of for the Cols. (Mr. J. H. Thomas, 26th Aug., Sir P. Cunliffe-Lister (now Lord Swinton), Nov., 1931, Mr. Malcolm MacDonald, 7th Oct., 1935, Mr. J. H. Thomas, 22nd Nov., 1935).

BOYD, Peter Ferguson.—B., 1893; geographer, Union of S. Africa, Sept., 1906 to Dec., 1911; postal asst., N. Rhodesia, June, 1912; ch. asst., Nov., 1916 to Apr., 1917; sect. office, Apr., 1920; ag. sec., Jan., 1925 to Apr., 1926; ag. dep. P.M.G., Jan.-Sept., 1927; P.M.G., Sept.-Dec., 1927; col. postmaster and tele., Fiji, Jan., 1928; nom. mem., leg. com., Oct., 1929; nom. comsnr., currency, Feb., 1930; P.M.G., 1930; P.M.G., N. Rhodesia, 1936.

BOYD, Robert.—B., 1890; ed. Campbell Coll., Belfast, and Trinity Coll., Dublin; schol. (B.A., 1913); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1913; offr., serv., 1915-19; asst. contrlr., labr., Nov., 1919; offr.,
DOMINIONS OFFICE AND COLONIAL OFFICE LIST.

Nov., 1920; asst. dist. offr., Mar., 1923; co-op. societies, May, 1923; asst. offr. in op. socs., S.S., Nov., 1924; offr., cls. III., 925; asst. dir., co-opern., F.M.S., and S.S., 27; on sp. deputation to India, Nov., 1928; co-opern., F.M.S. and S.S., June, 1930; nr., 1933; offr., cls. II., Nov., 1930; dir., nr. S.S. and F.M.S., Dec., 1933.

D. WILLIAM RYDER.—B. 1887; ed. Camp- coll., Belfast and Dublin Univ.; B.A., 1911; cadet, F.M.S., Dec., 1911; passed cadet, 1914; asst. dist. offr., May, 1915; dist. July, 1920; offr., cls. III., Dec., 1923; ag. treas. and collr., land rev., Malacca, May, offr., cls. II., Dec., 1928; 1st asst. sec. (I), Mar., 1929; sec. to res., Selangor, July, ag. Br. res., Selangor in addn., Apr.-May, regisr.-gen., statistics, S.S. and F.M.S., 1932; pres. munici. commsrs., Penang, 1933; dist. offr., L. Perak, Feb., 1934.

DYD-SHANNON, GODFREY ECCLESTON.—07; ed. Wellington and Cambridge; schol., John's Coll., 1926; 1st cls. class. tripso, pt. I., pt. II., 1929; Erowne med., 1928; B.A., 1930; apptd. after compet. exam., asst.-j. ser., 27th Oct., 1930.

OYDELL, Hon. THOMAS.—Served as engrnr. at R & W. Hawth.-B. 1887; ent. Peters nr. Newcastle—warden, county Africa, 1903; worked as counties, Apr., 1936; br. wks. and al.-offr., ANDRIES JACOB rban; stood v., D.S.O.—Joined civ. serv., S. African Labou 1896; served Mpfu (native) cam- rban at the gatupansberg and Anglo-Boer War, contested by elected veldt cornet, S. African Repub. 15-20, 21 and apt., permanent force (staff), Union bour Party, 1912; promoted major, and served as adj. offr., No. 6 and later as dist. staff and tels., 1st mil. dist., 1914; brig.-major, lat. June, 1924; German S.W.A. campaign, 1915; senator, S.ut.-col., Mar., 1915; dist. staff offr., 1916; BOYED, dist., with rank of temp. lieut.-col., 1915; empid., Aug., 1915; brev. lieut.-col., Sept., 1915; brig.-major, 2nd mounted brig., E. 1919; Mar., 1916; gen. staff offr. with rank of 136, headqrs., 3rd E. African divn., Apr., 1916; B.Cmed duty as dist. staff offr. No. 6 mil. 1920, Dec., 1916; transf. to defence headqrs., and dist. med. duty as ass't adjt.-gen., defence headqrs., Oct., 1917; ag. ch. of gen. staff and adjt.-gen., 1918; temp. rank of col., Nov., 1919; lieut.-col., 1st grade staff offr., Nov., 1919; brig.-gen., and ch. of gen. staff, Sept., 1920; combined post of ch. of gen. staff and sec. for defence, 1st Oct., 1922; maj.-gen., Nov., 1929; sec. for defence and G.O.C., Union Defence Forces, May, 1933; 1914-15 Star, Br. War Med., Victory Med., D.S.O., (1917), French Croix de Guerre; men. in desps., for serv. in G.S.W.A. campaign (1918), medal, Anglo-Boer oorlog.

BRINK, COLONEL CAROLUS, D.T.D., D.S.O.—B.1879; served Jameson Raid, S. African Republic, 1896; Mpefu campaign, Zoutpansberg, S. African Republic, 1898; Anglo-Boer War, Heidelberg commando, staff General Spruyt, 1899-1901; German S.W. Africa campaign, as brig.-major, 2nd Mounted Brig., Northern Force, 1914-15; German E. African campaign as G.S.O.I., 2nd E. African divn., 1916-17; Europe, Western Front, 1917-18; qualified, staff course, Bloemfontein, 1914; qualified, senr. staff course, Cambridge, 1919; qtrm.-gen. Union Defence Forces; ment. in desp.; Croix de Guerre(French); med., Anglo-Boer War.

BRACE, IVOR LLEWELLYN, B.L.—B. 1821; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1921; pol. mag., Grvr., Coast, 1930; ditto, Nigeria, 1931; crown, W.D. 1932.

BRADBURN, COL. WILLIAM ERNEST; Antonio—B. 1884; served, Imp. Yeomanry, African Constab., Jan., 1902 to (vis, K.C.M.G. King's Royal Hussars, Sept., 1915; cadet, Straits 1st King Edward's Horse, Kinay, 1888; 3rd mag. opinions Regt. (adjutant), Apr.-fr., Bukit Mertajam, local commit., Cyprus 1 sec., June, 1896; also mem., prison bd., Mar.,apore, June, 1896; collc. mod. Greek, 1921 and 1st 1898; commr., court of prison, Dec., 1922 to Aug., 1923; asst. col. sec. commdt., pol., Ja., Sept., 1903; ag. res. gen., to Oct., 1926; confirmed as fed. sec., continuing 1924; dep. chrs. gen., July, 1907 to Feb., 1908; dist. conserv. erak, Apr., 1908; res., Pahang, Nov., commr., S., Negri Sembilan, 1st Jan., 1910; Aug., S., S. Stilimts, 1910; chief sec., F.M.S., loca'lt; ret., Sept., 1920; apptd. agt., Malay potatoes Infr. Agency, Nov., 1920.

BROMLEY, Rear-Adml. ARTHUR, C.M.G. (1919).—B. 1876; ed. Farnborough Schol.; H.M.S. Britannia; joined navy, 1892; lieut., 1898; commodr., 1908; capt., 1915; served European War, 1913-18; H.M.S. Courageous, 1916-19; flag capt. to Vice-Adml. Napier commdg. light cruiser force; ret. list, 1922; rear adm., ret., 1926; a gentlemen usher to the King since 1921; pvtc. sec. (ceremonial and reception) to the S. of S. (Lord Passfield), 1931.

BROODBANK, ALFRED JOHN BERTIE.—B. 1888; dist. treas., N.Borneo serv., Aug., 1921 to Aug., 1931; asst. audr., in addn., Dec., 1924 to Apr., 1926, and Oct., 1928 to July, 1929; ag. audr., Aug., 1931 to May, 1932; dist. treas., May, 1932; asst. commr. cust., in addn., Mar., 1933; ag. commr. cust. and excise, Apl., 1934; commr. cust. and excise, Apl., 1935.

BROOKE, NEVILLE JOHN.—B. 1891; barrister-at-law, Middle Temple; asst. dist. offr., Nigeria, Jan., 1915; seconded to C.O., 1928; census offr., N. Prova., 1930; res., 1930; judge, high ct., Apr., 1934.

BROOKES, VICTOR S.—B. 1888; passed senr. Cambridge local exam., 1906; apptd. copyist, col. sec.'s office, Antigua, 1906; cashier, St. John's savings bank, Sept., 1908; acctnt., ditto, June, 1909; ag. acctnt., treasy. dept., June to Sept., 1909; clk. to commr. and exec. coun., Virgin Is., Apl., 1911; rev. offr., St. Kitts, Nov., 1914; acctnt., treasy., St. Kitts; ag. audit clk., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1918; ag. treas. and ag. mem., exec. and leg. couns., Aug.–Oct., 1934.

BROOKS, R. L.—B. 1900; ed. Charterhouse; Artists Rifles; commd., Guards Machine Gun Regt., 1920; passed inter. exam., Surrv.'s Inst.; dipl., forestry, Edinburgh, 1922; asst. conserv., forests, Uganda, 1922; seconded to admin., 1924; dep. conserv., forests, Trinidad, 1925; ag. conserv., forests in 1925, 1928, 1931 and 1933; conserv., forests, May, 1934.

BROWN, CHARLES CUTHBERT, B.A.—B. 1888; ed. Marlborough and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; schlr., 1909; Bell schlr., 1908; 1st cls. class. tripso, 1910; cadet, F.M.S., 1911; asst. dist. offr., Brumas, 1912-13; asst. sec. to res., Perak, 1913-15; 3rd asst. sec., Fed. secretariat and priv. sec. to ch. sec., 1915-19; asst. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Oct., 1919; dist. offr., Nov., 1922; offr., cls. III., Nov., 1923; offr., cls. II., Nov., 1928; offr., cls. IB., Apr., 1931; Br. advr., Trengganu, June, 1933; do., Pahang, Apr., 1935.
BROWN, CAPT. ERIC GORDON, B.Sc., A.M.I.C.E., Chtd. Civ. Engrn.—B. 1890; ed. Burton-on-Trent Gram. Schl., Malvern Coll., and Birmingham Univ.; asst. engrn., F.M.S. rly., Oct., 1919; dist. engrn., grade II., Oct., 1924; ditto, grade I., Oct., 1928; ag. divsnl. engrn., F.M.S. rly., Feb., 1933.

BROWN, FRANK LESLIE, M.C.—B. 1896; ed. Wilson Gram. Sch.; served in France, 1916-19; lieut., M.C., bar (ment.in desps.); prob., N. Rhodesia, Oct., 1919; asst. native commnr., Feb., 1922; native commnr., Oct., 1928; dist. offr., grade III, Apr., 1929; do., grade II, Apr., 1931; sec. as asst. sec., Aug., 1931; asst. col. sec., Jamaica, Aug., 1935.

BROWN, GEORGE PRITCHARD.—B. 1885; served with E. Africa pol. service batt., 1914-17; capt., Aug., 1916; Turkana expdn., 1916 (A.G.S. med.); asst. supt. of pol., Kenya, Apr., 1916; supt., pol., Kenya, Dec., 1923; staff offr. to commnr., pol., 1926; ag. dep. commnr., pol., July to Oct., 1931; offr., order of St. John of Jerusalem; asst. commnr., pol., Jan., 1933; ag. commnr. pol., June, 1934 to May, 1935.

BROWN, GERALD HORACE.—B. 1875; ed. Ottawa pub. schls. and Coll. Inst.; journalist and parly. correspondent; asst. dep. min. of labour, Canada, 1909-17; sec., reconstruction and development comttee; re-apptd. asst. dep. min. of labour, 1920; Canadian del. League of Nations, Internat. Lab. Confce., Geneva, 1921.

BROWN, HARRY WHIDDEN, B.A., LL.B.—B. 1868; ed. Acadia Coll., and Dalhousie Univ.; called to Nova Scotia bar, 1893; ent. civ. serv., Can., 1896, as priv. sec. to min. of militia and defence; dir. of contracts, militia dept., 1904; commnr., war purchasing commn., 1919, returning to militia dept., on the dissolution of that commn., 1920; asst. dep. min. of militia, 1920.

BROWN, HON. JAMES T., K.C., B.A.—B. 1871; ed. pub. and high schls., Huntington, Quebec, and McGill Univ.; called to bar, 1896; K.C., 1907; elec. to Sask. legislature, 1905; judge, sup. ct. of Sask., 1910; ch. just., ct. of King's Bench, 1918.

BROWN, JAMES VICTOR RAEBURN.—B.1897; ed. Falkirk High Sch. and Geo. Watson's Coll., Edin.; B.Sc. (Agric.) Edin., F.S.I.; Agr. and Suth. Hldrs., attd. R.F.C., Egypt, France, Italy, 1916-19; E.C.G. Corp.; post-grad. stud., Camb., 1925; prov. supdt., agr., Sierra Leone, 1925; dist. agr. offr., Tanganyika, 1931; seconded, Zanzibar, 1931.

BROWN, JOHN BATHURST.—B. 1904; ed. Shaftesbury and H.M.S. "Worcester"; asst. treas., Tanganyika Territory, 1925.

BROWN, KENNETH VINCENT.—B. 1890; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1915; mag., eastern dist., Trinidad, Dec., 1924; asst. mag., county of St. George West, 1926; mag., county of Victoria, June, 1930; do., St. George West, 1932; ag. judge in 1933, 1935 and 1936; 3rd puisne judge, June, 1936.

BROWN, MONTAGUE, M.B.E. (1933), B.Sc. Econ. (Lond.), A.C.I.S., A.L.A.A.—Office supt. and sec., gen. agrl. coun. and comttee. on agrl. economics and marketing; office, commrs. of income tax and super tax, 1915; 38th Bn. R. Fusiliers, 1918-19; Palestine govt. treas., 1920; dept. of agrl. and forests, 1922; sec., Palestine trade delegn. to Egypt, 1935.

BROWN, PHILIP PENTON, B.A.—B. 1903; ed. Rugby and Trinity Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1924; 2nd cls. hon., philos. and econ.; asst. mast., Achimota, Gold Coast, 1925.

BROWN, RALPH PHELPS.—B. 1877; ed. pu. and high sch., Nova Scotia and Boston; 2nd cls. elk., militia dept., Can., 1904; 1st cls. elk., 1907; asst. acctnt., 1910; asst. acctnt. and paymaster, 1917; ch. acctnt., 1918; gen. audr., 1920.

BROWN, ROBERT ALFRED.—B. 1888; draughtsman, Kano and Kaduna waterworks, Nigeria, 1914; asst. engrn., P.W.D., Nigeria, 1915; senr. exec. engrn., 1927; ag. asst. D.P.W. 1929-34; ag. dep. D.P.W., 1934; ag. supt., nat. adminstr. wks., 1935; asst. D.P.W., 1936.

BROWN, ROBERT ALLAN.—B. 1897; ent. P.O. savings bank, Dec., 1912; trans. to gen. bd. of control for Scotland, Feb., 1914; apptd. asst. dir. after compet. exam., Dec., 1914; junr. dir., 26th Apr., 1918; on mily. serv., July, 1915 to Mar., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920; trans. to C.O., 27th Apr., 1922; seconded as acctnt., treasury, Cyprus, 1928 to 1930; treasury, accnt., Gambia, Aug., 1930; asst. recor. gen., 1933; ag. recor. gen., June to Oct., 1934; J.P., 1936.

BROWN, THOMAS ALGERNON.—B. 1900; ed. Marlborough Coll. and Wellington Cadet Coll., S. India; 2nd lieut., 16th Cav., India Army, Feb., 1920; 1st lieut., Feb., 1921; active serv. Waziristan Field Force, Feb., 1920-May, 1922; lieut. regular army R. of O., June, 1922; B.A. (Oxf. Coll.), Oxford; barrister-at-law; 2nd cls. hcs. jurisprudence; called to bar, Inner Temple, Nov., 1926; crown coun., Gold Coast, July, 1933; ag. solr.-gen., Aug., 1934, Nov., 1935 and June, 1936.

BROWN, WILLIAM TWEEDIE STODART, B.Sc. (Edin.).—B. 1903; ed. St. Bees Schl., Edinburgh Univ. and St. John's Coll., Oxford; asst. comm. forests, Gold Coast, 1926.

BROWNE, GEORGE GILHAMSTONE, A.C.A.—B. 1898; acct., survey dept., S.S. and F.M.S., June, 1924; acct., P.W.D., S.S., Apr., 1932; sec. acct., F.M.S., Aug., 1934.

BROWNE, RAYMOND HAMILTON.—B. 1901; ed. St. Paul's Schol. and Downing Coll., Cambridge; B.A., LL.B.; called to bar, Gray's Inn, 1924; Midland circ.; advoc., Uganda bar, 1928; dist. mag. and coroner, Antigua, July, 1929; ag. atty.-gen., Leeward Is., on occasions; cls. mem., legis. coun., Antigua; res. mag., Jamaica, Nov., 1930; ch. regist., sup. ct. and prot. ct., Nigeria, 1936; regist., W. African ct. of appe., 1936.

BROWNE, ROLAND PAUL LAMBERT.—B. 1887; ed. at Marlborough Coll.; served as "élève externe" at British Consulate, Danzig, June, 1904 to July, 1909; asst. to res. commn., New Hebrides, Feb., 1912; commn., Cyprus, Jan., 1924; attd. col. sec.'s office in 1932 and 1934; admstr. offr., Jan., 1935; clk., exec. coun. in 1935 and 1936; ag. ch. ass't sec., various periods, 1936; ag. col. sec., July-Aug., 1936.

BROWNE, VERNON DENNISON.—B. 1892; secretariat clk., N.E.R. admstrn., May, 1909; mag. clk., N. Rhodesia (Fort Jameson) Ac., 1911; treas. clk., Mar., 1913; asst. acctnt., Mar., 1914; served in R.A.F., 1918-19; senr. asst. treas., N. Rhodesia, Apr., 1930; ag. dep. treas. on various occasions, 1927-34.

BRUCE, HON. R. RANDOLPH, B.Sc., C.E., F.R.G.S., LL.D. (Glas.).—B. 1863; ed. The Gymnasium, Old Aberdeen and Glasgow Univ.; emigrated to Can., 1887; on eng. staff, Can. P.Ry., 1887; silver-lead mining Br. Columbia, 1897-1926; lt.-gov., Br. Columbia, 1926-31; pres., Mine Owners Assn. of Interior, 1923-25; hon. col., 16th Can. Scottish; do., 29th Vancouver Regt.; Canadian minister, Tokyo, 1936.
BRUCE, Capt. The Rt. Hon. Stanley Melbourne, C.H. (1927), P.C. (1923), M.C. (1915).—Member of the H. of R. for Flinders since 1918; served in European War, 1915-17; capt., R. Fusiliers, Dec., 1914; twice wounded and invalided from the Army, Apr., 1917; Croix-de-Guerre, 1916; resigned chairmanship of firm of Paterson, Hughes ministry, Dec., 1921; prime min., Commonwealth of Australia, 1923-29; hon. min. and res. min. in London, Lyons ministry, 1932; leader Australian delegation to Ottawa conference, 1932; resigned from miny. and apptd. high commr. in Gt. Britain, 1933.

BRUCE, Thomas Dundas Hope, M.A. (Oxon.).—B. 1886; ed. Cheltenham Coll. and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; final hona., schol. of jurisprudence, 1906; admitted solr., sup. ct. of England, 1911; crown solr., Fiji, Nov., 1913; ag. atty.-gen., Jan. to May, 1915; ag. chief pol. mag., ag. egistr. of sup. ct., ag. reg. of titles, ag. curator of intestate and vacant estates, ag. public trustee, May to July, 1916; ag. atty.-gen., Dec., 1916; empty M.L.C., Aug., 1917; on active serv., Dec., 1917 to May, 1919; ag. atty.-gen., June, 1919 to May, 1920; dep. commr., Western Pacific, May, 1920; ag. res. commr., Gilbert and Ellice Is., May, 1920 to May, 1921; ag. atty.-gen., Fiji, May to Dec., 1921 and Mar. to Apr., 1922; apptd. a judi. commr. for the W. Pacific, Dec., 1921; seconded for sp. serv. with the W. Pacific High Commr. to preside over certain murder trials in the Solomon Is., Dec., 1921 to Mar., 1922; res. mag., Jamaica, July, 1922; called to bar, Gray's Inn, May, 1925; solr.-gen., Kenya, Apr., 1927; ag. atty.-gen., in 1932 and 1933; King's proctor, Dec., 1928; puisne judge, Gold Coast, 1936.

BRUCE, Thos. Robert.—B. 1862; 2nd clk., sol. sec. off., St. Helena, Jan., 1898; postmaster, St. Helena, Apr., 1898.

BRUCE-JONES, Douglas.—B. 1903; ed. Univ. Coll., Oxford; called to bar, Inner Temple, 1928; res. mag., Tanganyika Territory, May, 1935.

BRUEN, John Patrick, B.E. (Dub.).—B. 1904; asst. engr., Dr. Guiana, 1930; asst. engnr. to sea defence bd. of commrs., 1934.

BRUMAGE, Douglas O.—Asst. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., Sept., 1919; 1st grade admstve. offr., Kenya, Dec., 1930.

BRUNNEN, John Ewart.—B. 1893; admn. and dockyard schls.; H.M. Navy, 1914; admn., 1915; engnr., Tanganyika Territory, 1920; ag. asst. elec.engnr., 1922; ag. sen.asst.elec.engnr., 1924.

BRUNT, Abraham de Villiers.—B. 1879; Cape civ. serv., 1897; Tvl. civ. serv., 1901; commr., Robben Is., 1915; oh. clk., health dept., 1919; under sec., health dept., Union of S. Africa, 1932.

BRUTON, Charles Lamb, O.B.E.—B. 1890; ed. Radley Coll., and Keble Coll., Oxford, B.A., 1913; asst. dist. commr., Uganda, 1914; 1st gr. admstve. offr., 1924, senr. dist. offr., 1935; prov. commr., 1936.

BRYAN, Sir Herbert, K.B.E. (1925), D.S.O. (1917), C.M.G. (1906).—B. 1865; 2nd lieut. Linc. regt., June, 1892; lieut., Jan., 1894; capt., Manchester regt., July, 1899; brev. major, Nov., 1900; served in W. Africa, 1897-8; employed in Lagos Hinterland; also in operations on the Niger, including expdtion to Bassema (ment. in desp. medal with two clasps); served in N. Nigeria, 1900, slightly wounded (ment. in desp., clasp); served in operations in Ashanti, 1900; on the staff, D.A.A.G. (ment. twice in desp., medal); chief staff offr., Gambia expdt., 1901 (ment. in desp., medal with clasp); staff offr., W.A.F.F., Oct., 1901; employed at C.O., May 1902, to Nov., 1903; ag. col. sec., G. Coast, Nov., 1903; col. sec., G. Coast, Feb., 1904; ag. gov., on various occasions, 1904-09 and 1911-12; col. sec. and rev. commr., Jamaica, Aug., 1914; served in France, Flanders and Salonika, 1915-18; Constantinople, 1918-19; bvt. lieut.-col., bvt. col., D.S.O.; ag. gov., Jamaica, on various occasions, 1919, 1922, 1924-26; ret., 1925.

BRYANT, G.—B. 1900; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Apr., 1918; served with K.N.V.R., Sept., 1918, to Feb., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920; cler. offr., higher grade, 24th Aug., 1927.

BRYANT, George William.—B. 1887; ed. Emmanuel Coll., Camb. (math. scholar); B.A., 1909; M.A., 1916; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1910; passed final exam. in Malay, Dec., 1912; ag. asst. dist. offr., Kuantan, Mar., 1911; ag. asst. dist. offr., Klang, June, 1913; ag. dist. offr., Dindings, S.S., Apr., 1915; asst. dist. offr., Lower Perak, Mar., 1917; sec. to res., Negri Sembilan, Aug., 1918; offr., cls. IV, 1st Jan., 1919; sec., tin mining commr., in addition, Aug., 1919; addl. for sp. duty, Federal secretariat, Kuala Lumpur, July, 1922; ag. asst. sec. to gov't., F.M.S., Aug., 1924 and Apr., 1927; temp. asst. prin., C.O., May, 1926; ag. dist. offr., Raub, Mar., 1927; ag. chmn., sany. bd., Kuala Lumpur, Nov., 1927; offr. cls. II., Nov., 1927; offr., cls. I B, June, 1930; pres., munic. commr., Penang, Oct., 1930; ag. res. coun., Penang in addn., July, 1932; offr., cls. IA., res. coun., Malacca, Oct., 1934.

BRYCE, George.—B. 1885; ed. George Heriot's Schol., Edinburgh and Edinburgh Univ.; B.Sc., D.Sc.; Abyssinia, 1907-09; Madagascar, 1910-12; asst. botanist and mycologist, dept. of agr., Ceylon, 1913-23; served with H.M. forces, France, Germany, 1917-19; dir., agr., territory of New Guinea, 1923-26; del. to pan-Pacific confce., Australia, 1923; dir., Rubber Research Inst., Malaya, 1926-29; del. to pan-Pacific sci. congress, Java, 1929; dep. asst. dir., agr., Nigeria, 1930; asst. dir., agr., 1936.

BRYSON, Hugh Patterson, M.C.—B. 1898; ed. Royal Schol., Armagh; war serv., 1916-19; 2nd lieut., Tank Corps, 1917; France, 1918-19; cadet, F.M.S., Apr., 1921; attached to dist. office, Kinta, B. Geiab; offr., cls. V, 4th asst. sec. to gov't., F.M.S., Apr., 1924; offr., cls. V, attlt. offr., Trengganu, Apr., 1928; ag. sec. to res., N. Sembilan, May, 1931; offr., cls. III, Apr., 1933; asst. advr., Segamat, Feb., 1935; do., Kedah, Apr., 1936.

BUCHANAN, John Cecil Rankin, M.D. (Edin.), M.R.C.P. (E.), D.T.M. and H. (Eng.)—B. 1896; ed. Edinburgh Univ.; mily. serv., 1915-19; ment. in desps., 1916; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Aug., 1925; med. offr., Somaliland, June, 1928; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1931; senr. med. offr., Somaliland Prot., 1936.

BUCHANAN, Lawrence Alexander Cockburn, M.A. (Edin.), B.A. (Oxford).—B. 1903; ed. Edinburgh Acad., Edin. Univ. and Oxford Univ.; teacher's dipl., London Univ., 1929; supervsr. educn., Zanzibar, 1929.

BUCHANAN-SMITH, Sir Walter, Kt. Bach. (1935), C.M.G. (1930), M.C. (1918)—B. 1879; ed. Repton Schol.; Br. N. Borneo civ. serv., 1903; asst. dist. commr., S. Nigeria, 1909; ag. commr., lands, 1912, 1914 and 1916; addl., Nigeria Regt. in Cameroons 1914-15 and in E. Africa 1916-18;
ag. commr., lands, 1916; 1st cls. dist. off., 1918; res., 1921; ag. prin. astt. sec., S. Prov., 1921, 1923 and 1925; ag. sec., S. Prov., 1923 and 1925; staff grade, 1926; ag. lieut.-gov., S. Prov., 1928-29 and 1930; lieut.-gov., S. Prov., 1930; O.A.G., Nigeria, Sept.-Nov., 1930; ret., 1935.

BUCKLAND, LANGLLOT LIDDLE RORKE, B.Sc., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1897; ed. Oumlle Schl., Univ. of Cape Town, S.A.; Artists Rifles, 1918; astt. engnr., irrig. dept., S.A., 1919-28; astt. engnr., Tanganyika Territory, 1928; exec. engnr., 1929.

BUCKLE, DOROTHY M., O.B.E. (1951).—B. 1883; ed. Howard Gardens Munic. Secondary Schl., Cardiff and Whitelands Training Coll., Chelsea; 1st cls. B. of E. teachers certif.; astt. prin., Raffles girls schl., Singapore, 1908; ag. prin., 1909; prin., 1911.

BULKELEY, GEORGE VICARY OWEN, A.M.I. Mech. E.—B.1892; ed. Victoria Coll., Jersey and Owen's Coll., Manchester; 1st cls., rly. operating, Lond. Schl. of Economics; port man., Kenya and Uganda rlys. and harb., 1926; gen. man., Nigerian rly., 1933; dir., transport, Nigeria, 1936; author "Mechanical Appliances for handling Railway Traffic" (1922); "Railway and Seaport Freight Movement" (1926).

BULL, HAROLD ROBERT, M.A., Barrister-at-Law, Middle Temple.—B. 1888; ed. Framlingham and Queen's Coll., Camb.; open entrance scholar, Queen's Coll., 1907; foundation scholar, 1908; 1st cls. hons., Nat. Sci. Tripos, Part I, 1909; 3rd cls. Maths. Tripos, Part I, 1910; cadet, S.S., Nov., 1911; attached to Chinese protectorate, Dec., 1911; passed cadet; offl. collr., stamp duties, Selangor, Negri Sembilan and Pahang, Apr., 1924; dep. contr., lab., Dec., 1924; sheriff, Singapore, Mar., 1925; 2nd mag., do., Oct., 1925; astt. offl. assignee, do., Jan., 1928; offr. cls. II, Nov., 1929; ag. dist. judge, Singapore, Apr., 1930; offr., cl. IB, Mar., 1932; dist. judge, Singapore, Sept., 1932.

BULL, OSWIN BOYS, M.A.—B. 1882; dir., Lerotholi tech. schl., Basutoland, 1931; dir., educn., 1935.

BULLOCK, G.—Ast. traffic manager, Uganda Railway, Apl., 1919; senr. astt. supt., transportation dept., Mar., 1927.

BULMAN, JOSEPH WAUGH, A.M.I.Loco.E.—B. 1893; ed. Petershill Pub. Schl., Glasgow; served in Navy, 1914-19; loco. foreman, Cyprus govt. rly., Nov., 1919; astt. loco. supt., Oct., 1927; astt. rly., July, 1935.

BULSTRODE, B. P. E.—B. 1887; ed. Dulwich Coll. and Wadham Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1913; astt. priv. sec. to gov., Leeward Is., 1907-1909; chief clk., govt. office, and clk. of couns., St. Lucia, Oct., 1914; ag. inspr. of schools, St. Lucia, Jan. to May, 1915; priv. sec. to admstr., Feb., 1916 to Apr., 1917; seconded from govt. office for sp. duties, Feb., 1917; priv. sec. to ag. admstr., Apr., 1917; trans. to Gambia as 2nd astt. recvr-gen., Oct., 1918; offr.-in-charge, secretariat on several occasions between 1920 and 1926; oz. clk., leg. coun., Oct., 1920; 2nd astt. col. sec., Jan., 1921; clk., exec. and leg. couns., on many occasions; ag. inspr., schls., Apr. to Sept., 1926; astt. col. sec., Gold Coast, 1931.

BUNBURY, CECIL MOLESWORTH.—Ed. privately; employed at Crown Bridge Works, W. Bromwich, 1895-1898; Great Central, Great Northern and City Rlys., 1898-1900; served in S. African War, 1900-1902 (medal with 4 clasps); CentraS. African Rlys., 1902-1904; astt. engnr., Uganda Rly., 15th Jan., 1906; maintenance engnr., Jan., 1925; ag. ch. engnr., 1925.

BUNNY, JOSEPH, F.L.S.—B. 1865; Reading Schl. and Emmanuel Coll., Cambridge; astt. conserv., forests, S. Nigeria, 1917; sec., 1918; senr. conserv., 1922; attended intercolonial confce., in Australia and N.Z., 1928; Nigeria and Sierra Leone, 1928; ag. director, Nigeria in 1929.

BUNTING, BENJAMIN, N.D.A., F.L.S.—B. 1889; astt. agriculturist, F.M.S., Malaya, do., Dec., 1914; agriculturist, Mar., 1915; sp. duty in Ceylon, Jan., Feb., 1930.

BUNTING, ROBERT HUGH, F.L.S.—B. 1892; of agriculture, Sierra Leone, 1913-15; astt. agric. and govt. mycologist, Gold Coast, 1915; ag. dir. of agric. on several occasions.

BURDETT, HENRY LEATHAM, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1887; war serv., Nov., 1914 to Aug., 1919; astt. engnr., Basutoland, 1921; transferred to Tanganyika as road engnr., 1929.

BURGE, G. H. K.—B. 1890; cadet, Royal Naval and Ellice Islands, Jan., 1915.

BURGESS, CLAUDE BRAMALL.—B. 1890; Epworth Coll. and Christ Ch., Oxford; B.A., greats; cadet, Hong Kong, Oct., 1932; sec. for Chinese affrs., Feb., 1933; astt. sec. of impts. and expts., Aug., 1935; admin. urban coun., Mar., 1936; pol. mag., June, 1936.

BURKE-GAFFNEY, E.M.O.D.—B. 1890; Belvedere Coll. and Univ. Coll., Dublin; astt. engnr., F.M.S., P.W.D., Jan., 1920; engnr. Jan., 1929; ag. state engnr., K.C.A., Nov., 1934.

BURKE-GAFFNEY, H.J.O'D., M.D.—B.A.O. (Dub.).—B. 1901; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Aug., 1925; astt. bacteriologist, 1929; senr. pathologist, 1935.

BURNER, ERIC ANDERSON.—Ed. at King's Schl.; comand., R.F.A., France, Belgium, Germany, 1915-18; astt. dist. commr., Coast, 1920; dist. commr., 1924.

BURNETT, BERTRAM DAVIDSON.—Ed. Port Elphinstone Pub. Schl. and Int. Acad.; war serv., 6th Batt. Gordon Highlanders, 1914-19; foreman of wks., 2nd grade, Port Gold Coast, Feb., 1920; headmast., trade schl., Apr., 1924.

BURNETT, CAPT. FREDERICK, M.C.—B. 1890; ed. Ashwater Schl., Devon, and Univ.; war serv., R.E., France, 1914-19; bar; divl. agrl. offr., Ceylon, 1920; regt., co-op. socs., 1926; vice-prin., agt., Peradeniya, 1926; dep. dir., agt., Br., 1930.

BURNS, SIR ALAN CUTHBERT MARSHALL, K.C.M.G. (1936), C.M.G. (1927).—B. 1879; appd. to treasy. and cust. dept., St. Kitts, Leeward Is., Mar., 1906; clk. to govt., 1909; ag. mag., Anguilla, 1910; dep. commr. and J.P., St. Kitts, 1911; ag. clk. and govt. to admstr., Dominica, 1912; supervisor of S. Nigeria, Nov., 1912; astt. sec., Nigeria, 1914; col. sec., Bahamas, Feb., 1924; mem., H. of A., 1925-28; del. to W. Ind. confce., London, 1926; astmtd. govt. on various occasions, 1924-28; dep. ch. sec., Nigeria, 1929; acting ch. sec. and gov't. dep. on various occasions, 1929-34; gov't. and commr.-in-chief, Honduras, 1934; on active serv. with W. Afr. Regt., 1914-15; adjutant, Nigeria Land Corps, 1915; served with Egba Expeditionary force, joint compiler, Index to Laws of Leeward Is., 1910; compiler, Nigeria Handbooks, 1911; author of "A History of Nigeria" 1929.

BURNS, R. E., LL.B., London (1908); clk., registr. & off., St. Kitts, June, 1898; agt.,
BURT, ROBERT HILLHOUSE.—B. 1896; apptd. after compet. exam. clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. ser. and assigned to C.O., 15th Mar., 1915; cler. offr., higher grade, 30th Apr., 1923; staff offr., 1st Oct. 1936.

BURTON, GERALD JOHN LLOYD, M.C., B.A.—Plant breeder, agrl. dept., Kenya, Jan., 1921; senr. plant breeder and experimentalist, 1935.

BURTON, WILLIAM, Barrister-at-law, Gray's Inn.—B. 1884; B.A., Cantab., 1st cls., div. III, clas. trip., 1906; 2nd cls., pt. II., hist. trip., 1907; cadet, F.M.S., 1907; ast. dist. offr., K. Pilah, cls. V, cont. as mag., K. Baharu, and harbour., T. Anson, and ast. dist. offr., K. Kangsar, 1911; ast. dist. offr., B. Padang, 1913; mag., Ipoh, 1913; ast. regis., sup. ct., Ipoh, 1914; mag., Seremban, 1916; offr., cls. IV, Jan., 1918; offr., cls. III, Nov., 1919; regis., sup. ct., K. Lumpur, 1920; offr. assignee in addn., May, 1921; regis., sup. ct., July, 1921, cont. offr. assignee in addn.; offr., cls. II, Nov., 1924; do., cls. I.B, dep. legal advr., F.M.S., May, 1926; temp. judge, F.M.S., Mar., 1928; puisne judge, S.S., Apr., 1929; judge, Johore, Jan., 1936; ag. ch. just., S.S., May, 1935.

BURTON, WILLIAM ELLIOT.—M.D., C.M., McGill Univ., 1910; ag. temporary res. surg., Barbados general hosp., 1910; ag. med. offr., St. James' parish, Barbados; ag. visiting physician, leper asylum; ag. surg. to police, dist. II., Barbados, 1911; mag. and med. offr., Anguilla, Leeward Is., 1912; inappr. public health, St. Kitts-Nevis, Aug., 1918.

BUSH, BERTRAM OLIVER, Assoc.M.Inst.C.E., Chtd. Civ. Engr.—B. 1890; ed. Hoe Gran. Schl. and Plymouth Tech. Schl.; ast. engrnr., Perak, F.M.S., Jan., 1920; ditto, K. Kangsar, Feb., 1921; ditto, K. Pilah, Dec., 1924; ditto K. Pilah and Jelebu, Oct., 1925; exec. engrnr., D.P.W.'s office, Jan., 1929; sr. drainage and irrign. engrnr., Perak, Jan., 1932; ag. ast. advr., drainage and irrign., Malay States in 1933 and 1934.

BUSHE, SIR HENRY GRATTAN, K.C.M.G. (1936), C.B. (1932), C.M.G. (1927)—B. 1886; called to the bar, 1909; Western circuit, 1910-11; S. Eastern circuit, 1911; Herts and Essex sessions, 1916; sec. to royal comsn. on the contracts between the War Office and Sir John Jackson, Ltd., 1916-17; ag. legal astt., C.O., Nov., 1917; legal astt., 1st Jan., 1919; legal adviser to D.O. and C.O., 1st Apr., 1931.

BUSTARD, FRANK HARCOURT.—B. 1888; joined Northumberland Fusiliers, May, 1903; seconded to K.A.R., Aug., 1913; commissioned in field, May, 1916; coy. commdr., Apr., 1917; ment. in desps, 1918; Somaliland campaign, 1920; capt., reg. army R. of O.; temp. astt. sup., Tanganyika pol., May, 1925; cadet, Zanzibar pol., Oct., 1925; supt., pol., May, 1926; ag. astt. comsnr. and ag. comsnr., pol., 1935-36.

BUSWELL, HENRY HOPE.—B.D. (Serampore, Calcutta); L.C.P. (hons. English and French), Fellow of L'Institut Francais du Royaume Uni.; ast. chaplain, Quatre Bornes and Moka, Mauritius, 1908; civ. chaplain, Beau Basin and Rose Hill, Mauritius, 1909; civ. chaplain of Seychelles, 1919; sub. dean, St. Paul's Cathedral, Victoria, Seychelles; chmn., Seychelles free library; mem., bd. of educn., Seychelles.

BUTCHER, JAMES WILLIAM.—B. 1889; ed. N.Z. state schl. and Waitaki Boys' High Schl.; ent. registr.-gen.'s dept., 1906; statistical branch, 1912; ch. compiler, census and statistics office,
1915; asst. govt. statistician, 1929; govt. statistician, 1932; N.Z. rep. at Br. Empire Conf. of statisticians, Ottawa, 1935.

BUTCHER, PERCY GEORGE, B.A. (hons. Oxon.).—B. 1890; ed. Perse Sch., Cambridge and Exeter Coll. Oxford; war serv., Devonshire Regt., 1915-19; France, 1916-19; adm. offr., cls. IV, Nigeria, Aug., 1919; Arabic dipl. Schl. of Oriental Studies, 1927; ag. res., Bornu Prov., various periods since 1928; dep. res., Aug. 1934; adm. offr., cls. I, 1936.

BUTLER, CHARLES OWEN.—B. 1896; on mily. serv., 1914-19; asst. dist. commnr., Gold Coast, 1921; dist. commnr., 1924; asst. col. sec., 1928; ag. sec., asst. col. sec., Apr.-Sept., 1932.

BUTLER, CHARLES RICE.—B. 1885; ed. Trinity Coll., Dublin, and at the Sorbonne, Paris; B.A.; supt., educ. dept., Nigeria, Apr., 1914; attchd. Nigeria Regt., 1917-18; ch. inspr., S. Provs., 1930; ag. asst. dir., educ., S. Provs., 1933 and 1935; prin., Higher Coll., Yaba, 1933.

BUTLER, ERNEST CECIL.—B. 1900; clk., Basutoland, 1920; sub-insp., B.M. pol., 1927; war serv., Apr., 1917-Mar., 1919.

BUTLER, FREDRICK BERRY LEWIS, F.L.S.—B. 1890; ed. Shaw Schl. (Berks) ent. R. Botanic Gardens, Kew, 1912; served in European War, 1915-19; agr. instr., E.A.P., 1919; man., Mazeras and Kibos experimental farms, E.A.P., 1921; agr. supervisor, Kenya, 1923; grader and inspr., Kenya, 1925; ch. grader and inspr. of produce, Cyprus, Jan., 1935.

BUTLER, G. G., M.B.E., B.A., M.D., B.C., Cantab. (hons. nat. sci. tripus), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), certif., L.S.T.M. (with distinc- tion).—Apptd., W.A.M.S., Sierra Leone, Apl., 1911; seconded for sp. investigation under yellow fever commn., May, 1913 to June, 1914; served Cameroons Expdy. Force, Jan., 1916 to Apl., 1916; temp.-capt. (gen. list) Jan. to Apl., 1916; seconded for serv. with R.A.M.C., 1916-19; dir. of laboratory, Tanganyika Territory, Jan., 1920; ag. D.P.M.O., Mar., 1924; dir., med. research inst., Gold Coast, May, 1928.

BUTLER, HON. RICHARD LAYTON, M.P. (S. Australia)—M.P. for Wooroora 1915-18 and since the elections of 1921; leader, party, liberal party and of opposition, Dec., 1925; premier, treas. and min. of rlyw., 1927-30; now leader of opposi-

BUTTERFIELD, HARRY ROBERT FRDERICK.—B. 1896; ed. Westminster City Schl.; 2nd lieut., Midd'x. Regt., Mar., 1915; served Great War, 1914-19; 6th K.A.R., Tanganyika Territory, 1922 to 1925; ret., 1926; admin. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1927; asst. dist. offr., May, 1929; capt., 6th K.A.R. R. of O., July, 1930; ag. res. mag. and dist. registr., June, 1931-Sept., 1932; author, "Index to Laws of Tanganyika Territory, 1935."

BUTTERS, HENRY ROBERT.—B. 1898; ed. Glasgow High schl. and Glasgow Univ., 1st bursar, 1916; cadet, Hong Kong, Jan., 1922; asst. to sec. for Chinese affrs., 1924; dist. offr., North, 1925; ag. dep. registr. and 2nd pol. mag. in addn., 1925; 3rd asst. col. sec., 1926; 2nd asst. col. sec. and dep. clk. of couns., June, 1928; ch. ast. to sec. for Chinese affrs., 1929; 2nd pol. mag., 1930; 2nd asst. col. sec. and dep. clk., couns., 1932 and 1933; pol. mag., Kowloon, Sept., 1932; 2nd asst. col. sec. and dep. clk., couns., Oct., 1933; extra asst. col. sec., Jan., 1934; dep. clk., couns. in addn., Sept., 1934; prin. asst. col. sec. and clk., couns., Sept., 1935; 1st pol. mag., Dec., 1935; P.M.G., Mar., 1936.

BUTTERS, SIR JOHN HENRY, KT. BA., M.I.E.E., M.A.M.I.C.E., etc.—B. 1882; Taunton Schl. and Univ. Coll., Southampton; engnr. and gen. man., govt. hydro elec. dept., Hobart, Tasmania; chmn., Tasmanian com. of the C'wealth advisory com. of science and industry; pres., Tasmanian Inst. of Engnr., chem., econmr., fedl. cap. comnr., Canberra, Nov., 1924; ret.

BUTTON, FRANCIS JENKINSON, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1887; ed. Burnley Gram. Schl.; war ser., East Lancs Regt. and R.T.C., Aug., 1914-Jan., 1919; asst. engnr., F.M.S., Apr., 1920; engnr., Apr. 1929; ag. sr. exec. engnr., J.B., Nov., 1932.

BUXTON, C. E. V.—Asst. dist. commn., Africa Prot., Oct., 1919.

BYNOE, ALLAN KENNETH.—B. 1881; ed. civ. serv., Barbados, 1900; ch. clk., pol. zct., dist. "A," 1922; ag. pol. mag. of vari- dists., on several occasions, 1922-26; pol. dist. "C," 1927; do. dists. "D" and "F," 1928.

BYRNE, BRIG.-GEN. SIR JOSEPH A., G.C.M.G. (1934), K.C.M.G. (1928), K.B.E. (1918), C.B. (military 1916).—B. 1874; joined R. Inniskilling Fliers, 1893; served in S. African War, 1899-1902; wounded; served with central judicial comm. Pretoria, 1903-06; major, 1914; bt. lieut. comm. 1915; brig.-gen., 1916; asst. adjutant-gen., W.O., 1916; dep. adjutant-gen., Ireland, 1916; (C.B. and desps.) inspr.-gen., R.I.C., 1916; ad. to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1922; gov., Seychelles, 21st July, 1922; assumed govt., 26th Sept., 1922; gov. and commr.-in-chief, Sierra Leone, 1922; gov. and commr.-in-ch., Kenya and high commr. for transport, 1931; ret., 1936.

BYRON, FREDERICK ANGUSTUS WILLIAM.—B. 1900; served in R.E. and Royal Corps Sign., 1918-1924; awarded M.S.M. and ment. in ser. for serv. on N.W. Frontier, India; wireless on Gold Coast, 1925; electrician in charge of services, Falkland Is., 1930; broadcast on Sierra Leone, 1933.

CABABE, THALES.—B. 1887; clk., P.W.F., Cyprus, 1910; ch. clk., secretariat, 1931; asst. postm.-gen., 1934; ag. P.M.G. in 1934 and 1935.

CADE, REGINALD COURTNEY.—B. 1891; Academie de Caen and in Germany; joined ser., Aug., 1914; served in France, June, 1915 to Sept., 1916 and Jan., 1917 to Mar., 1918; lieut., list, H. Qrs., Home Forces, till Mar., 1918; invalided out of army; junr. examr., clearances (enemy debts), Sept., 1920; senr. examr., June, 1921 to Dec., 1929; temp. adm. offr., O.C.O., Feb., 1930.

CADMAN, SIR JOHN, K.C.M.G. (civil), C.M.G. (1916), M.Sc., M.I.M.E., F.G.S.—B. 1895; ed. High Schl., Newcastle-under-Lyme; Durham Univ. Coll. Sc.; Staff, C.C. sch., 1895; B.Sc. (Dunelm.), hons., 1899; M.Sc., 1901; pres., Union soc., 1898; certif. colliery man., 1901; asst. gen. man., Silverdale coal and iron works, Staffs., 1900; asst. agt., Walter Scott, Ltd., Collieries, Durham, 1901; H.M. inap. of man. (H.O.), East Scotland, 1902; ditto, Staffordshire, 1903; govt. mining engnr., Trinidad and Tobago, 1904; ret., 1922; author of prize papers on "The Ore Deposit" before Inst. of Mining Engrs.

CAHAN, HON. CHARLES HAZLITT, B.A., LL.B., LL.D., K.C.—B. 1861; ed. Yarmouth Seminary and Dalhousie Univ.; leader of conserv. party in Nova Scotia legis., 1890-94; 1st el. to H. of C., Canada at g.e., 1925; re-el., 1926, 1930 and 1935; sec. of state in Bennett cabinet, 1930.
CAIN, Henry Oliver.—B. 1892; Europ. ar., 1914-18; 21st Lancers 1910; Indian Sig. rv., 1916-23; qmr. st., Somaliland pol. force, 25; pay and qmr., 1928.

CAINE, Sydney, B.Sc. (Econ.)—B. 1902; ed. arrow County Schl. and London Schl. of Economics; B.Sc. (Econ.), with 1st cls. hons., 1922; ptd. after compet. exam., ass't inspr. of taxes (land Rev.), 1923; apptd. after compet. exam., st. prin., C.O., Nov., 1926; prin., 8th Nov., 31; visited W. Indies and B. Guiana as sec., Indian sugar coman., 1929-30; sec., managing dir., Imp. Inst. of Entomology, Oct., 31.

CAIRNS, Thomas Crawford, B.Sc.—B. 1900; I. Edinburgh Acad.; B.Sc. Edinburgh Univ., 24; entomologist, Empire Cotton Growing corp.; seconded to divn. of entomology, Union S. Africa; cotton investigator, Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1928; dist. agrt. offr., Tanganyika Territory, May, 1930.

CALDECOTT, Sir Andrew, K.C.M.G. (1937), T. Bach (1935), C.M.G. (1932), C.B.E. (1926).—B. 1884; ed. Uppingham (schol. and exh.), and Oxford (school), 2nd cls. lit. hum., 1907; B.A., Exeter Coll., 1907; cadet, F.M.S., 1907; dist. offr., Selangor, 1911; dep. contr., labr., 1913; 2nd asst. sec., Fed. Sec., 1916; seconded for sp. duty in connexion with Br. Empire Exhibn., while on leave in England, Jan., 1923; town planning adminstr. and state valuer, Ipoh, Mar., 1926; chmn. housing and P.W.D. enquiry comtees, Dec., 1926; dep. contr., lab., Malaya but continues ag. under sec., S.S., July, 1927; offr. cls. Ia. sec., postal affrs., S.S. and F.M.S., Apr., 1928; ag. Br. res., N. Sumatran, Dec., 1929; ag. Br. res., Perak, Oct., 1930; ag. Br. res., Selangor, May, 1931; ag. ch. to govt., F.M.S., July, 1931; supernumerary staff offr. of rank of ch. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Mar., 1932; col., sec., S.S., Dec., 1933; O.A.G., S.S. and high commr., Malay States, Feb.-Nov., 1934; gov. and commr.-in-ch., Hong Kong, Dec., 1935; gov. and commr.-in-ch., Ceylon, 1937; Knight of Grace, Order of St. John of Jerusalem, 1936.

CALDER, James.—B. 1898; ed. Glasgow Univ.; M.A.; war serv., 1916-19; cadet, S.S., Apr., 1921; attd., treasry., S'pore, June, 1921; offr., cls. V, Apr., 1924; asst. supt., govt. monop., S'pore and asst. contrlr., rubber in addn., Aug., 1926; ditto, Penang, Mar., 1927; offr., cls. IV, Apr., 1928; dist. offr., Alor Gajah, Dec., 1928; asst. dir., co-opern., S.S. and F.M.S., Dec., 1929; ag. asst. atvr., B. Pahat, Apr., 1931; offr., cls. III, Apr., 1933; mag., Seremban, May, 1935; do., K. Lumpur, Dec., 1935.

CALDER, Hon. James Alexander, B.A., LL.D.—B. 1868; ed. Ingersoll pub. schls., pub. and high schls., Winnipeg; Manitoba Coll.; hon. grad. in science, Manitoba Univ., 1888 (silver medallist); called to bar, North-West Territories, 1906; prin. of Moosejaw high schl., 1891-94; inspr. of schls., N.W.T., 1894-1900; dep. commr. of educ., N.W.T., 1901-05; elec. to Sask. ass. at first g.e., 1905; prov. treas. and commr. of educ., in Scott min., Sept., 1905; unsucc. cand. for Milestone div. at g.e., 1908; elec. for Saltcoats by bye-elec., Dec., 1908; min. of immigr. and colonization in federal union govt., Oct., 1917; elec. to H. of C., Canada, for Moosejaw, Dec., 1917; pres., Canadian privy coun., July, 1920; called to senate, Sept., 1921.

CALDER, John A., M.A.—B. 1889; ed. at Harris Acad., Dundee and Edin. Univ.; Vans Dunlop scholarship in history, 1910; M.A. with 1st cls. hons. in history, 1911; 1st cls. hons. in philosophy, 1912; apptd. after compet. exam., 2nd cls. clk., C.O., Nov., 1912; ag. 1st cls. clk., 8th Dec., 1917; on military service from 16th Sept. to 10th Dec., 1918; prin., 1st Apr., 1920; visited S. Africa, N. and S. Rhodesia, Nyasaland, Tanganyika, Zanzibar, Uganda and Kenya as sec., E. Africa Parly. Coman., Aug. to Dec., 1924; asst. sec., 27th June, 1933.

CALDWELL, Reginald Percival.—B. 1894; held various appts., Fiji, 1910-17; served with 1st Batt., K.R.R., France, 1917-19; 1st cls. clk., treas. and sec., returned sailors and soldiers land settlement scheme and returned sailors and soldiers advances bd. of control, 1922; asst. commr. for Fiji, Br. Emp. Exhib., 1924; col. audlt. dept., Dec., 1924; asst. audr., Tanganyika Territory, Jan., 1925; ag. senr. asst. audr., June, 1925; asst. audr., Uganda, July, 1930; ag. senr. asst. audr., Aug., 1930; senr. asst. audr., Kenya, Dec., 1935.

CALLAN, Hon. John Bartholomew, K.C. (1934), B.A., LL.B.—B. 1882; ed. Christian Bros. schl., Dunedin, and Otago univ., N.Z.; pty. legal practice many years; served in war as capt., 3rd batt., N.Z.R.B.; lecturer in torts, Otago univ., 1912-33, and dean of faculty of law, 1924-33; mem., coun. of legal educ.; formerly pres. Otago law soc.; judge, sup. ct. of N.Z., 1933.

CALTHROP, Lancelot Henry Calthrop.—B. 1904; ed. Blundell's; pol. probationer, Hong Kong, Nov., 1924; seconded as junr. dist. offr., Weihiwei, 1926; asst. supt., pol., 1928; J.P., 1928; passed in Mandarin, 1928; attd. Punjab pol., 1930-31.

CALVERT, Hubert, C.S.I., C.I.E., I.C.S. (ret.), B.Sc.—B. 1875; regis. co-op. socs., Ceylon, Mar., 1935.

CALWELL, H. G., B.A., M.B., B.Ch., B.A.O. (Hons.) (Belf.), D.T.M. & H. (Lond.) (Gold Med., Diseases of Children, Belfast).—B. 1901; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Apr., 1931.

CAMACHO, Fabien Joseph.—B. 1898; ed. St. Wilfred's Coll., N. Staffs.; army, France 1917-19; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1923; mag. and legal advr., Montserrat, Nov., 1930 to May, 1932; mag., E. counties, Trinidad, Nov., 1932; ag. solr.-gen., Aug., 1935; ag. mag., Victoria, 1936.

CAMACHO, Maurice Vivian.—B. 1885; ed. St. Edmund's Coll., Herts.; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1906; ag. atty.-gen., Leeward Is., in 1919 and 1920; atty.-gen., Dec., 1920; K.C., 1924; judge, West Indian ct. of appeal for hearing of certain appeals, 1924; solr.-gen., Trinidad, 1927; ag. atty.-gen., Nov., 1928 to Apr., 1929 and Dec., 1930, to Jan., 1931; ag. judge, sup. ct., Apr. to June, 1929 and Jan. to June, 1931; atty.-gen., Jamaica, 1931.

CAMBRIDGE, Ralph.—M.A. Hertford Coll., Oxon.; B. 1878; 3rd asst. mast., Queen's Royal Coll., Trinidad, Sept., 1901; 1st asst. mast., Apr., 1918; 2nd mast., July, 1920; prin., Queen's Royal Coll., Sept., 1:27.

CAME, Frederic Harold Roberts, M.B.E. (1936), A.C.G.I., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1900; ed. Taunton Schl. and Impl. Coll. of Sci., S. Kensington; asst. engr., P.W.D., Uganda, 1925.

CAMERON, Sir Donald Charles, G.C.M.G. (1932), K.C.M.G. (1926), K.B.E. (1922), C.M.G. (1918).—B. 1872; ed. at Rathmines School, Dublin; entd. Br. Guiana civ. ser., 1890; 5th class clk., secretariat, 1891; 4th ditto, 1895; 3rd class and
despatch clk., 1895; 2nd class, 1899; priv. sec. to ag. gov., 1896, 1897, 1898 and 1901; ag. ast. gov. sec. and clk. of councils, 1900-1901, principal clk., secretariat, 1901; priv. sec. to gov. of Newfoundland (with permission of S. of S.) whilst on leave, 1902; ast. col. sec., Mauritius, July, 1904; ag. col. sec. in 1904-5-6-7; temp. transf., to S. Nigeria as ast. sec., Jan., 1908; principal ast. sec., 1911; sec. to S. Nigeria liquor trade inquiry comte., 1909; ag. prov. commr. in 1910, 1911 and 1912; ag. col. sec., 27th Feb. to 24th Aug., and 5th Sept. to 3rd Oct., 1912, deputy gov. in 1921-23; cent. sec., Nigeria, 1st Jan., 1914; ch. sec. to gov., 1st Jan., 1921; ag. gov. in 1921, 1923 and 1924; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Tanganyika Territory, Sept., 1924; ditto, Nigeria, 1931.

CAMERON, SIR EDWARD J., K.C.M.G. (1916), C.M.G. (1905).—Ed. at Shrewsbury Schl., Clifton Coll., and Merton Coll., Oxon; priv. sec. to Sir C. C. Lee, gov., Bahamas, Jan., 1883; ast. col. sec. and treas., S. Leone, Nov., 1883; J.P. for the Sttlmt., and visiting justice, Freetown Gaol; ag. col. sec. and treas., Dec. 1885, to July, 1886; pres., Virgin Is., Feb., 1887; mem. Leeward Is. legis. coun., 1887, and exec. coun., 1888; comnr., Turks Is., Mar., 1893; ag. judge sup., May to Dec., 1893, Jan. to June, 1895, and Apr. to July, 1898; admstr., St. Vincent, May, 1901; admstr., St. Lucia, Apr., 1909; ag. gov. Windward Is., June to Oct., 1909, July to Dec., 1911, and in 1912; representative of St. Lucia, and chmn. of W. Indian delegates at reciprocity conf. at Ottawa, Mar., 1912; gov., Gambia, Feb., 1914; assumed govt., Apr., 1914; ret., 1920.

CAMERON, KATHERINE ROSS, M.B.E. (1926).—Nursing sister, Basutoland, 1911; ag. matron, 1914; nursing sister, Nyassaland, 1919; matron, 1923.

CAMERON, MAJOR SIR MAURICE ALEXANDER, K.C.M.G. (1914); C.M.G. (1900), late R.E. B. 1865; first commn. in Roy. Engrs., Ang., 1874; dep. col. engr., S. Sttlmts. Dec. 1883, to Apr., 1892; during which he acted about two years and a half as col. engr., and survr.-gen., and was a mem. of exec. and legis. couns.; apptd. one of the crown agts. for the colonies, 1895-1920.

CAMILIERI, LUIGI A., LL.D.—B. 1892; matric., Malta Univ., 1907; LL.D., 1913; sl. for legis. assem., 1921; mag., 1924; judge, 1930.

CAMELLE, VRE BERNARD.—B. 1898; ed. Malvern Coll. and Royal Milv. Acad., Woolwich, 1915; R. Arty., 1915-21; active serv. (France), 1916-18; ast. dist. comnr., Nyassaland Prot., 1927-30; ast. treas., 1930-36; seconded, Sonali-land Prot., 1936.

CAMPBELL, ALBERT BERNARD.—B. 1883; ast. store keeper, Baro Kano rly., 1909; seconded, Nigerian Regt., 1917; ast. ch. storekeeper, 1920; ch. storekeeper, Nigeria, 1928.

CAMPBELL, ARCHIBALD, A.M.I. Mech.E.—B. 1891; ed. Royal Tech. Coll., Glasgow; N.B. Rlv. Co. 1906-11; engrg. design dept., C.A., 1914; war serv., 1916-18; ast. engrg., 1921; dep. engrg. (mech.), 1935.

CAMPBELL, COLIN BRUCE, B.A., M.C.—B. 1890; ed. Leatherhead Schl. and Lincoln Coll., Oxford; supt., educn. dept., N. Provs., Nigeria, May, 1921.

CAMPBELL, DAVID CALENDER.—B. 1891; ed. Foyle Coll., Derry and Edin. Univ.; ast. sec., Tanganyika, Dec., 1919; ast. ch. sec., 1933; dep. ch. sec., Uganda, Feb., 1936.

CAMPBELL, COL. GEORGE FREDERICK COOK, C.M.G. (1919), V.D. (1908).—B. 1858; ed. Govt. Coll., New Zealand; entd. New Zealand serv., 1874; dep. commr. of taxes, 1894-194; dep. supt., advances to settlers' office, 1894; dep. valuer-gen., 1897-1904; valuer-gen., 1904; gen. man., state fire insurance office, 1904; commr. of taxes, 1910-2; sec. to treas., rev. gen., pay-master-gen. and supt. of state savings office, 1913; contr. and audr.-gen., 1922.

CAMPBELL, JAMES EDWARD FRANCIS, C.B. (1937), M.A.—B. 1879; ed. Christ Church, Oxford; double lit. cls. hon., called to bar, Middle Temple; Order of the Nile; served throughout war; major, R. Artillery, 1916-18; ent. Pay-admtn., Mar., 1919; ast. dist. gov., Jerusalem-Jaffa dist., 1920; dist. commr., Jesuitari, 1932.

CAMPBELL, J.M., M.B., Ch.B. (Ed.), D.P.H. (Camb.), D.T.M. (Liv.) (Alan Milne med., 1897; med. offr., Kenya, Nov., 1923; health offr., Tanganyika Territory, Nov., 1923.

CAMPBELL, LACHLAN BAIN, M.C., M.A., M.I.C.E. (Lond.).—B. 1882; ed. Auckland Grammar Schl. and Canterbury Univ. (N.Z.); 30 years' serv. in N.Z. pub. works; comnr., borough of Napier (during recent period following earthquake), 1931-33; sec., same, 1933.

CAMPBELL, OWEN NEIL.—B. 1884; ed. Auckland gram. schl. and Auckland univ. (N.Z.); ent. N.Z. lands and survey dept.; served overseas as lieut., N.Z. Engrs.; 1914-15, ch. drainage engr., lands dept., 1922; ch. comnr. of crown lands, 1927; dep. under-comnr. of crown lands and survey dept., 1934; native trustee, under-sec., native dept., 1935.

CAMPBELL, S. McNEILL.—B. 1893; ed. Hamilton Acad., and Glasgow Univ.; M.A. clia. hona. Classics) 1915; G.U.O.T.C. 1914; on military service, Jan., 1916 to Mar., 1919, with Cameronians (Scottish Rifles) Div. and R.A.F., Egypt and Palestine; July, 1917; capt., R.A.F., Nov., 1918; temp. clk., in C.O., Apr., 1919; apptd. by exec. commrs., 2nd cl. clk., C.O., Jan., 1920; prin., 1st Apr., 1920; priv. sec. to perm. sec. (Sir J. Masterton Smith), Ap., 1921-23; ag. prin., 3rd Oct., 1923; prin. 1st Oct., 1925; sec., W. Indies Closer Union Com., Nov., 1932-Mar., 1933.

CAMPIGLI, LIEUT.-COL. GEORGE MEE (R. of O.), M.C., M.Inst.T.—B. 1890; ed. Vict. state rly., 1905-14; served in Aust. Forces in Gallipoli and Palestine, 1914-18; in dep.; capt. (staff capt.), May, 1917; ast. dir., rly. traffic, 1918; ast. dir., dist. offr.-in-ch., Palestine milv. rly., 1919; ast. to civ. govt. as ast. gen. man. Palestine, 1920; lieut.-col. R. of O., July, 1921; man. in 1922, 1924, 1926-1927-28; mem. ad. bd. to Palestine govt. for commerce and indus., Mar., 1928.

CAMPION, LIEUT.-COL. SIR WILLIAM ROBERTS, K.C.M.G. (1924), D.S.O. (1917), T.D. (1914-1870); ed. Eton and New Coll., Oxford; lieut.-col. 4th Batt., R. Sussex Regt., 1915; col. M.P., Lewes divn., Sussex, 1910-24; gov. Australia, 1924-31.

CAMELLE, CHARLES, C.M.G. (1937), B.Sc., LL.D., F.R.S.C., F.G.S.A.—B. 1875; St. John's Coll., Winnipeg; grad., Man. Univ., 1894; post grad., geol., of Queen's Univ., Kingston, Harvard, and Massachusetts Inst. of Tech., Boston; geol., Algoma Cent. Rly., 1901-
Canadian Northern Rly., 1902-03; geol., geological surv. of Can., 1904; geol., investigations and explns. in Br. Columbia and N. Can., 1904-20; in charge of B.C. and Yukon br. of the geol. surv., 1918; dep. min., federal dept. of mines, 1920; apptd., Dom. fuel bd., 1921.

CANNON, HON. LAWRENCE ARTHUR DUMOLIN, B.A., LL.L., LL.D.—B. 1877; ed. Commercial Coll., Arthabaskaville, Que. (Can.), Quebec Seminary and Laval Univ.; gov.-genl.'s med., A.B., 1896; LL.L., 1899; LL.D., 1927; admitted to bar, 1899; K.C., 1910; M.L.A. (Que.), 1916 and 1919; mem. of coman., to revise and consolidate statutes of Quebec, 1923; bataillonier, Quebec bar, 1924; hon. sec., Canadian Bar Assn., 1927; judge, King's bench (Que.), 1927; judge, sup. ct., Canada, 1930.

CAPETOWN, ARCHBISHOP OF, MOST REVEREND FRANCIS ROBINSON PHELPS, D.D., Ed. Keble Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1886; M.A., 1889; D.D., 1916; bishop of Grahamstown, 1915; archbishop of Capetown and metropolitan of the church of the province of S. Africa, 1931.

CARBERY, JOHN EDWARD DONTON, LL.B., McGill.—B. 1893; served in Great War, 1915-19; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1925; clk. ota., Jamaica, 1927; ag. res. mag., 1927-32; res. mag., Nov., 1932.

CARBONELL, JOHN ROUSE.—B. 1908; ed. Shrewsbury Schl. and St. Catharine's Coll., Camb.; 3rd cl. geog. trip., 1929; 3rd cl. anthrop. trip., 1930; B.A., 1930; supt., Tanganyika Territory, 1930.

CARDIN, HON. PIERRE JOSEPH ARTHUR Richelieu.—B. 1879; ed. Sorel Comm. Coll. and pvt. teachers; studied law, Laval Univ.; bataillonier Richelieu bar sec.; first elect. to H. of Canada, at g.e., 1911; re-elec., g.e., 1917 and g.e., 1921; mem., privy coun. and min. of marine and fisheries, 1924; re-elec., by accl. after assuming office, 1924; re-elec., at g.e., 1925, 1926, 1930 and 1935; resigned portfolio with King Cabinet, 1926; re-apptd., min. of marine and fisheries, Sept., 1926; min. of pub. wks. in King cabinet, 1935.

CARDINALL, ALLAN WOLLEY, C.M.G. (1937).—B. 1887; ed. Winchester Coll. and Heidelberg; cond. Matric., 1914; asst. dist. comsnr., Ashanti, S. Coast, 18th Aug., 1914; dist. comsnr., G. Coast, 1st Jan., 1921; ag. comsnr., S. Prov., N.T., Apr. to Aug., 1928; ag. comsnr., N. Prov., N.T., Jan. to June, 1929; ret., 1932; comsnr., Cayman Is., 1934.

CAREW, WILLIAM DENMOND.—B. 1899; ed. Longowes Wood Coll., Ireland and Trinity Coll., Dublin; 2nd lt., 13th D.C.O. Lancers, Indian Army, 1918; served N.W. Frontier, 1919; cadet, Fiji, 1921; dist. comsnr., 1925; ag. ch. pol. mag., or various periods, 1928-31; called to bar (Gray's Inn), 1930; ag. atty. gen., sup. ct. criminal circuit, Sept., 1931 and Sept., 1932; dist. mag., N.W. Viti Levu, and dist. registrar, sup. ct., inch. of Lautoka dist. regv., 1932-34; ag. ch. pol. mag., regis. sup. ct., pub. trustee and off. rec. in bankruptcy, Dec., 1934; jud. commr. for W. Pacific, New Hebrides and ag. Br. judge of joint internat. ct., condominium govt., New Hebrides, Mar., 1935.

CAREY, CECIL WILLIAM VICTOR.—B. 1887; B.A., LL.B., Trinity Coll., Dublin; called to bar, Dublin, 1910; asst. dist. comsnr., Uganda, Oct., 1915; mag., 1918; admst.-gen., custodian of enemy property, off. rec. in bankruptcy, 1919; crown coun., Nigeria, 1921; ag. solt.-gen. in 1923-30; puisne judge 1930.

CARLTON, ERIC JAMES WATTS.—B. 1908; ed. Bedford Sch., and Trinity Coll., Oxford; passed in sch. of agr., B.A., 1930; cadet, Tanganyika Territory, 1931; asst. dist. ofir., 1933.

CARMICHAEL, FRANK BERNARD.—B. 1883; loco. supt., Trinidad govt. rly., June, 1928; ag. supt., rly., July, 1934 to Jan., 1935.

CARN CROSS, HON. SIR WADE CHARLES FREDERICK, KT. BACH. (1922).—B. 1885; ed. privately; mem., N.Z. House of Reps., 1890-1902; M.L.C. since 1903; chmn., comte., of L.C., 1910-18; speaker, 1918.

CARR, EDWARD THOMAS WHITMORE, B.A., T.C.D.—B. 1883; sub-inspr. of constab., Trinidad, Oct., 1907; inspr., July, 1916.

CARR, FREDERICK BERNARD.—B. 1893; admstve. ofir., cle. IV., 1919; asst. sec., S. Provs., secretariat, 1925, 1930 and 1931; asst. sec., Nigerian secretariat, 1928, 1929 and 1930; ag. senr. asst. sec., 1930; sec., coman., of inquiry in S.E. prov., 1930; ag. prin. asst. sec., S. provs. secretariat, 1930 and 1932; admstve. serv., cls. II, 1933; ag. res., 1928, 1933, 1934, 1935 and 1936; admstve. ofir., cls. I, 1936.

CARR, JAMES BENJAMIN.—B. 1889; ed. Bedford Mod. Sch. and Culham Training Coll. (Oxford Diocesean); European ast. mast., Victoria Inst., K. Lumpur, Jan., 1911; with H.M. Forces, Oct., 1914 to Feb., 1920; Raffles Inst., S'pore, Jan., 1921; headmast., T. Kurau govt. eng. schl., June, 1926; asst. inspr., schl., S'pore, in addn., Sept. to Nov., 1926; headmast., K. Pilah govt. eng. schl., Dec., 1928; headmast., Rangoon Rd. schl., S'pore, Dec., 1930; group supvr., S'pore, June, 1935.

CARRIE, WILLIAM JAMES, M.A., B.Sc. (1914).—B. 1891; ed. at George Watson's Coll., Edin., and Univ. Edin.; cadet, civ. ser., Hong Kong, 1914; passed in Cantonese, 1917; on military service, 1918 to 1919; asst. col. treas., 1920; J.P., 1922; 2nd asst. col. sec., 1922; sec., Sui On piracy coman., 1922; sec., stocks and shares coman., 1925; asst. supt., impts. and expts. dept., 1926; head, sany. dept., Nov., 1927; asst. col. sec. and clk. of coun., Oct., 1928; head, sany. dept., 1929 and Nov., 1934; sec., salaries coman., 1928 and 1929 in addn.; supt., census, 1930-31; senr. asst. col. treas., Nov., 1931; ag. P.M.G., 1933; chmn., urban coun., Jan., 1936; ag. sec., Chinese affrs., and mem., exec. and leg. couns., Mar., 1936.

CARROW, LIEUT.-COMM. JOHN HINTON, R.N. (Ret.), D.S.C.—B. 1890; ed. Clifton Coll.; admstve. ofir., cls. IV., Nigeria, June, 1919; ditto, cls. I., Dec., 1932.

CARRUTHERS, ANGUS WILLIAM.—B. 1879; ed. Daniel Stewart's Coll., Edin.; Impl. serv., 1897; O.F.S. serv., 1904; asst. dir., census, U. of S.A., Feb., 1918; dir., census, Jan., 1934.

CARSON, ANDREW HOWARD, A.M.I.E.E., M.I.R.E., Chtd., Elec. Engnr.—B. 1895; ed. High Sch., R. Acad. and Educat. Inst., Inverness, Univ. Tech. Coll.; Br. P.O. eng. dept., Jan., 1912; asst. teleg. engnr., P. & T. dept., F.M.S., Mar., 1921; engnr., P. & T., S.S. & F.M.S., Oct., 1926; ag. sr. engnr., on various occasions, 1932-34; sr. engnr., and sec. to Johore as ch. teleg. engnr., July, 1934.

CARSON, JAMES COBURN, M.B., B. Ch., B.A.O. (Queens Univ., Belfast), D.T.M. (Meth. Coll., Belfast).—B. 1894; 11th Battn. R. Irish Rifles and 126th Baluchistan Inf., 1915-18; med. ofir., S.S., Apr., 1924; gen. hosp., Penang, May, 1924; ag. prof., anatomy, med. coll.,
S'pore, May, 1926-Jan., 1927; med. offr., S'pore, June, 1927; ag. ch. med. offr., Malacca, Jan., 1928 and Sept., 1931; med. offr., P. Wellesley, Jan., 1932; do. S'pore, June, 1933; do., K. Lumpur, Nov., 1933; ag. ch. med. offr., Penang, July, 1935.

CARSTAIRS, CHARLES YOUNG.—B. 1910; ed. George Watson's Coll., Edin., and Edin. Univ.; M.A. (hons. in hist.); apptd. after compet. exam. asst. prin., D.O., 24th Oct., 1934.

CARTER, CYRIL WALTER, Assoc. M.Inst.C.E., M. Int. Nav. C.—B. 1900; ed. Berkhamsted Schl. and Crystal Palace Engnr. Schl.; mil. serv., 1918-19; seconded to Tanganyika Govt., 1927; dep. res. engr., Egyptian govt., 1929; exec. engr.-in-ch., harbr. wks., Tanganyika, 1930; asst. engr., harbr. dept., Nigeria, 1934; asst. port engr., 1935; port engr., 1936.

CARTER, EDWARD STANLEY.—B. 1888; ed. Carpenter's Co. Tech. Inst.; war serv., 1914-19; asst. engr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1920; seconded, Kowloon-Canton Rly., 1926-27 and in 1929.

CARTER, HUGH CLAY, M.C., M.E.I. (Canada).—B. 1884; ed. St. Albans Schl.; asst. engr., Br. Honduras, Jan., 1921; ag. dir., pub. wks., Apr., to Dec., 1923; D.P.W., Br. Honduras, May, 1924.

CARTER, WILLIAM HOWARD.—B. 1887; asst. inspr., schls., Barbados, 1934.

CARTER, SIR WILLIAM MORRIS, KT. BACH. (1919), C.B.E. (1918), B.A., B.C.L.—Ed. at King's schl., Canterbury, and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; open exhib., in mod. hist., Jan., 1892; class. mods.
