LINFORD, GEOFFREY BINDER.—B. 1891; pol. prob., F.M.S., Nov., 1912; astt. comsnr., pol., June, 1918; 1st astt. comsnr., pol., Ipoh, Jan., 1923; paymaster, Jan., 1925; regisr., criminals, S.S. and F.M.S., Mar., 1925; adjt., F.M.S., pol., Feb., 1934.

LINTON, REGINALD DUKE, B.Agr., A.I.C.T.A.—B. 1904; ed. Mountjoy Sch., Dublin, Belfast Univ. (B. Agr.) (distinct.), 1927), Oxford Univ. and Imp. Coll., Trop. Agr. (A.I.C.T.A.), 1929; dist. agrl. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1929.

LISSAMAN, ARTHUR EVELYN, F.S.I., M.Inst. M. & Cy. E.—B. 1897; ed. Luton Modern Schl. and Coll., Estate Management, Lond.; mil. serv., R.E.'s, 1915-19; survr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1921; engrnr., 1923; ag. engrnr., Feb., Nov., 1935.

LITTLEJOHN, NORMAN KNIP, A.M.Inst. C.E., A.M.I.Struct.E.—B. 1900; ed. Robert Gordon's Coll. and Robert Gordon's Tech. Coll., Aberdeen; engrnr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1926.

LIVERPOOL, EARL OF, RT. HON. ARTHUR FOLJAMBE, P.C. (1917); G.C.B.; G.C.M.G. (1914); G.B.E. (1918); K.C.M.G. (1912); M.V.O. (1900); Viscount Hawkesbury of Kirkham; Baron Hawkesbury of Haselbich.—B. 1870; ed. Eton and Sandhurst; 2nd lieut., Rifle Brigade, 1891; lieut., 1893; capt., 1894; staff capt., Dublin district, July, 1900 to Dec., 1901; served in S. LIVINGSTON, WILLIAM, A.M.Inst.C.E., P.A.S.Inst.—B. 1890; ed. Guiana, 1924; seconded for duty on reconnaissance survey to interior, Br. Guiana, Mar.-Aug., 1927; D.P.W., Bermuda, Sept., 1929.

LLIWELLYN, JOHN LIONEL BRETHERTON LLWELLYN, M.A. Oxon. (hons. hist.), F.R.G.S.—B. 1889; astt. dist. comsnr., E.A.P., 22nd Apr., 1914; ag. dist. comsnr., N. Frontier, Sept., 1915.

LLOYD, EDGAR BRINEY.—B. 1894; ed. Aberavon; clk., land dept., E.A.P., 1919; ag. land asst., 1920; ag. regis., crown lands, documents and titles, 1921.

LLOYD, T. I. K.—B. 1896; ed. Rossall Schol. and Caius Coll., Cambridge (schol., 1914); cadet, Royal Mil. Acad., 1915; 2nd lieut., R.E., 1916; served in Egypt and Palestine, ment. in desps., 1917; app'td. under re-construction scheme, asst. prin., miny. of health, July, 1920; att. to C.O. as asst. prin., Dec., 1921; ag. prin., D.O. 4th Sept., 1929; seconded for serv. as sec. to Palestine coms., 1929.

LLOYD, WILLIAM BUTLER.—B. 1880; ed. Shrewsbury, and Christ Church, Oxford; M.A.; called to the bar, 1905; dist. and stip. mag., Mauritius, 1913; mag., Rodriguez, 1916; mag. for occupied territories of German East Africa, 1919; mag., Tanganyika Territory, Nov., 1919; pol. mag., S. Leone, June, 1922; puisne judge, Mar., 1924; ag. ch. just., Oct., 1924 to May, 1925, and from July, 1928; puisne judge, sup. ot., Nigeria, 1930; ag. ch. just., July-Oct., 1933.

LLOYD, WILLIAM HENRY, O.B.E. (1937)—B. 1882; ed. Hampden Gunnery Schol.; asst. acctnt., open lines Baro-Kano rly., N. Nigeria, July, 1912; transf'd. to admistr. ser., Apr., 1917; admistr. offr., cl. I, Dec., 1932.

LLOYD, HON. SIR WM. FREDERICK, K.C.M.G. (1919).—B. 1864; ed. Owen's Coll., Manchester and Durham Coll. of Science, Newcastle-on-Tyne; bachelor of law, London Univ., 1894; D.C.L., Victoria Univ., Toronto, 1901; vice-principal, Bishop Field Coll., St. John's, Newfild., 1891; editor, "Evening Telegram," 1904; M.H.A., Trinity dist., 1904; leader of the opposition, H. of A., 1916; with Sir Edward (now Lord) Morris formed a National Govt., becoming attorney-general, 1917; ag. prime minister, 1917; prime minister, 1918.

LLOYD-BLOOD, CAPT. L.I.N., M.C., B.A., Barrister-at-law.—B. 1896; ed. Tonbridge and Trinity Coll., Dublin; 2nd lieut., 5th R. Dublin Fusiliers, Jan., 1916; France, 1916-18; ment. in desps.; dep. regist., sup. ct., Kenya, Oct., 1920; regist., July, 1921; asst. atty.-gen., Nyasaland, Aug., 1924; ag. atty.-gen., in 1925, 1926, 1927, 1929 and 1932; solr.-gen., Palestine, 1932; ag. atty.-gen., in 1933 and 1934; atty.-gen., Cyprus, Sept., 1936.

LOCK, FREDERICK JOHN.—B. 1888; ed. LOCKHART, F. R., M.B., Ch.B. (Mar.), D.T.M. & H. (London).—B. 1897; milit. med., 1916-19; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1924.

"LOCKHART, SIR JAMES HALIANE STEPHENSON, K.C.M.G. (1908); C.M.G. (1888); F.R.S.; M.R.A.S.; LL.D. (Hong Kong Univ.), 1915; Edin. Univ.; Greek medalist, etc.; cadet, Hong Kong 1878; attached to the C.O. for service 1879; passed cadet, 1882; supt. opium戒烟, Mar., 1883; asst. col. sec. and asst. auditor, Aug., 1883; ag. regist. gen., 1884; ag. regist.-gen., 1887; and M.L.C., 1889; mem ex-coun., 1891; chmn., bd. of exams in China, 1891; ditto governing body Queen's Coll.; regist., sup. ct. in prize, Nov., 1914; senr. col. sec., Apr., 1894; col. sec. and regist., Mar., 1895; sp. commr. to rep. on extent of bndry. of H. Kong, 1898; rep. of bd. to delimitate bndrys., for both of which he thanks of S. of S., 1899; rector of coll. of Chinese, 1895-1902; commr. of Wehau, Jan., 1902; assumed govt., May, 1907; 1920.

LOCKHART, KENNETH SPENCER.—R. M. copyist, admistr. office, Dominica, 1908; clk., regist. office, 1910; 2nd rev. offr., harbmr., Nevis, 1913; ag. acctnt., treas., 1913; also sec. to quarantine bd., and clk. to treas. bd. of health; govt. trade agt., to ensure rep. on conditions re W.I. labourers at Domingo, Nov., 1918; rev. offr., St. Kitts, 1920; ag. audit. clk., Sept., 1920; 2nd clk., dept., July, 1921; capt., St. Kitts-Nevis-Dominica Force; ag. 1st clk., treas., May-Sep., 1921; audit clk., St. Kitts-Nevis, June, 1922; treas. tax commr., 1924; prin., Oct., 1929.

LOCKHART-SMITH, WILLIAM JAMES.—1902; ed. Uppingham; 1st clk., Kowloon Mag., Hong Kong, July, 1924; attd. land office, 1926; admitted solr., sup. ck., Eng., Nov., 1933; dep. O.R. and reg. tr. marks in aids., Aug., 1933; O.R. and reg. tr. marks, Sept., 1934-35; asst. crown solr., 1934; asst. offr., Aug., 1935; ag. land offr., Apr., 1936.

LOCKIE, JAMES REACH.—B. 1904; ed. Coldbeltown and Edin. Univ., B.Sc. (forestry, cls. hon.); asst. conservtr., forests, Br. India, Nov., 1926; do., Nigeria, 1936.

LOGAN, SIR EWEN REGINALD, Kt., F.R.S. (1928), J.P.—B. 1868; ed. at Charterhouse and Exeter Coll., B.A., 1891; M.A., 1895; stud. Inner Temp., Jan., 1894; called to bar, Nov., 1894; joined Middlex. and N. London sess. and criminal, 1900; serv. in Boer war as 2nd Lieut. 65th squad., I.Y., 1901; Queen's medal and clasps; mines dept., Transvaal govt., Aug., 1902 to Apr., 1902; asst. res. mag., Transvaal, May 1902 to May 1904; mag. E. Africa Prot., 1905; chief just., Seychelles, 1914; admin. govt. from July, 1916 to Mar., 1917 and May to Oct., 1918; drafted in conjunction with Alfred Gellé Esq., barrister-at-law, code of procedure for Seychelles; recd. thanks of state; puisne judge, G. Coast, June, 1920; senr. seniory from Mar., 1920; senr. puisne judge, Dec., 1922; ag. ch. just., Mar. to Nov., 1925; Feb. to Mar., 1925; ch. just., Bahamas, Feb., 1925; chmn., bd. of educn., Aug., 1925; high ct., N. Rhodesia, May, 1927; ret., Jan., 1931; J.P., County of London, 1935.
OGAN, WILLIAM MARSTON, O.B.E. (1933).—Ed. Bristol and Brasenose Coll., Oxford; M.A.; ed. Bridgeman prize man, B.A.; asst. commr., East Africa Prot., Mar., 1913; sec., committee of supplies, 1914-15; hon. lieut., attached list, 1915-17; ag. dist. commr., 1918 Dec. to July, 1921; ag. senr. asst. sec., Sept. Nov., 1920 and July, 1921 to June, 1924; 1st adm. off., June, 1924; sen. asst. sec., 1924 to Mar., 1925; ag. asst. col. sec., to Oct., 1925 and in 1926; sec., local govt. comm., 1926; ag. asst. col. sec., 1927; prin. commr. for local govt., lands and attm., 1928; commr., local govt., lands, attm. and mines, 1933.

OLTGEN, W. G.—B. 1894; on mily. serv., May, 1916 to 18th Feb., 1920; temp. clk., O.S.O., Mar. 1920 to 27th June, 1922; apptd. for compet. exam., cler. off., O.S.O., 27th June, 1922.

ONDON, GEORGE ERNEST, C.M.G. (1936).—B. 1889; ed. at Warwick and Downing Coll., Cambridge (schol.); ist nat. sci. tripods, 1910; hist. pos., 1911; B.A., 1911; cadet, F.M.S., 1911; ols., V., 1914; on mily. serv., 1916-19; ols., Glouc. Regt.; offr., cls. IV, 1919; sec. to Pahang, 1920; offr., cls. III, Nov., 1923; p. contr., rubber expts., S.S. and F.M.S. and p. supervisor, rubber F.M.S., Nov., 1924; cls. II, Nov., 1928; ag. finan. commr. and audr. gen., Jan., 1930; sec. to res., Perak, Sept., 1930; cls. IIB, Apr., 1931; a. under sec. to govt., F.M.S., Mar., 1932; ag. Br. res., N. Semban, June, 1933; under sec. to govt., F.M.S., 1934; lsec., Gold Coast, 1934.

LONEY, GEORGE HENRY.—B. 1871; ed. Timaru Pub. Schl.; ent. N.Z. printing and stationery dept., 1895; supt., 1922; govt. printer, 1933.

LONG, CAPT. HERBERT EDWARD.—B. 1887; Kendrick Schl., Reading; B.E.F., Egypt; Gallipoli, Salonika, Mar., 1915 to Feb., 1918; India and Aden, Mar., 1918 to April, 1921; dist. offr., Somaliland, July, 1921; H.B.M.'s vice-consul, Jigjiga, Sept., 1927; consul, Oct., 1930; cons. consul, Harar, Nov., 1931; dist. offr., Somaliland Prot., Mar., 1935.

LONGHURST, ALBERT HENRY.—B. 1877; geological commr., Ceylon, Oct., 1935.

LOOS, W. T.—B. 1885; apptd. cls. III, Ceylon v. serv., Mar., 1934; office asst., Trincomalee ach., Mar., 1934.

LORD, EDWARD ERNEST.—B. 1898; ed. Queen Elizabeth's Schl., Clifton; mily. serv. with L.A.C. and R.A.F., 1916-18; offr. Imp. cust. and excise, Jan., 1920; asst. to commr. of cust., Kenya and Uganda, Oct., 1924; senr. coll. of cust., Jan., 1935; ag. dep. commr., cust., on various occasions since 1930.

LORD, GEORGE ERIC LUDWIG, R.A.—B. 1907; ed. Felstead Schl. and Christ's Coll., Camb.; col. and dist. dept., June, 1930; asst. audr., Gold Coast, July, 1930; do., Palestine, 1935.

LORD, LIUT.-COL. J. E. C., C.M.G., D.S.O., V.D.—Ent. Tasmanian civ. ser., 1886; commanded 40th Batt. A.L.F. in European War from Feb., 1915 to Aug., 1919; commands 12th Inf. Brig., Australian Mil. Forces; A.D.C. to the gov.-gen.; commr. of pol., Tasmania.

LOUDOUN, WILSON ANDERSON.—B. 1874; pub. schl., Chatham, New Brunswick; asst. audr.-gen., 1902; audr.-gen. of New Brunswick, 1907; now comptroller-general.

LOUW, ERIC H.—B. 1891; ed. Beaufort West High Schl. and Univ. of Stellenbosch, S. Africa; A. and LL.B. (Cape); called to bar, 1916 and practised at sup. ct., Grahamstown; el. M.P. for Beaufort West, 1924; first S. African commr. to U.S.A. and Canada, 1925; high commr. for Union of S. Africa, London, Mar., 1929; min. plenipotentiary, Washington, Oct., 1929; do., Rome, Nov., 1933; do., Paris, 1934.

LOUW, JAN DANIEL, B.A.—B. 1888; ed. Victoria Coll. and Univ., Stellenbosch; educ. serv., Cape Prov., 1912-1930; ch. translator, Pretoria, 1930.

LOWE, CLARENCE VAN RIET, B.Sc., Assoc. M.I.C.K., Cape Town, F.R.S., S. Africa, etc.—B. 1894; ed. Grey Coll. Sch., Bloemfontein and Univ. of Cape Town; dir., archaeological bureau, Johannesburg.

LOWE, CAPT. HERBERT JOHN, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1892; ed. St. Andrew's Coll. and R. Vety Coll., Dublin; lieut., R.A.V.C. (S.R.), 1914; capt., R.A.V.C. (S.R.), 1915; war serv., France, 1914-18; vety. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1918; senr. vety. offr., Apr., 1923; ag. dep. ch. vety. offr., May to Dec., 1926; ag. dir., vety. serv., in 1932 and 1933; ag. dep. dir., do., in 1933.

LOWICK, HENRY CAPELL, P.A.S.I.—B. 1882; ed. Northampton County Sch.; land survr., P.W.D., Hong Kong 1910; asst. engnr., 1913; engr. in ch. archt., 1923; exec. engnr., do., 1930; ag. A.D.P.W., 1934, 1935 and 1936; J.P., 1935.

LUCAS, HON. SIR EDWARD, KT. BACH (1921).—M.L.C., S. Australia 1900-1918; agt. gen. for S. Australia in London, 1918-24.

LUCETTE, EDWARD HENRY, B.A. (Oxon.), M.C.—B. 1896; on mily. serv., Apr., 1915; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., May, 1921; attd., Anuradhapura kach., June, 1921; attd., Trincomalee kach., Mar., 1922; attd., col. sec.'s office, Nov., 1922; pvt. sec. and ag. A.D.C. to the gov., July, 1924 to Apr., 1925; pol. mag., Campbell, Feb., 1926; ditto, Kandy, Dec., 1926; dist. judge, Badulla, Apr., 1928; pol. mag., Colombo, Feb., 1929; addnl. dist. judge, Kandy, July, 1931; asst. regist., co-op. socs., Nov., 1931; asst. gov't. agt., Kegalle, Oct., 1932; regist., co-op. socs., Oct., 1934; dep. regist., do., Mar., 1935.

LUCIE-SMITH, SIR ALFRED VAN W., KT. BACH (1911).—Ed. at Rugby; solr., Br. Guiana, 1877; called to bar, Mid. Tem., 1881; ag. solr.-gen., Br. Guiana, 1882 to 1887; pres. dist. ct., Famagusta, Cyprus, 1887; Limasol, 1892; ag. Queen's advoc., 1893; ag. judge, cons. ct., Constantinople, 1896; res. mag., Kingston, Jamaica, Nov., 1896; puisne judge, B.G., Jan., 1898; ag. ch. just., 1900-01; one of the compilers of the "Rules of Court," 1900; ch. just., Trinidad and Tobago, 1908; pres., W. Indian ct. of appeal, May, 1920; ret., 1924.

LUCIE-SMITH, JOHN ALFRED, O.B.E., V.D.—B. 1888; ed. Stonyhurst Coll.; col. sec.'s office, Br. Guiana, 1905-06; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1910; advoc. and solr., S. Stiltns, 1910-14; on mily. serv., 1914; twice ment. in despe.; ag. pres., dist. ct., Trinidad, 1920; asst. mag., Port of Spain, 1920-23; pres., dist. ct., Cyprus, 1924; passed exam. in mod. Greek, Dec., 1925; ag. puisne judge for various periods, 1926-27; ag. crown pros., Nov., 1926; puisne judge, Oct., 1927; one of the compilers of the "Rules of Court," 1927; puisne judge, Trinidad, 1929; chmn., oil and water bd., 1931; puisne judge, Kenya, 1931; mem., ct. of appl. for Eastern Africa.

LUCIE-SMITH, JOHN DUDLEY.—B. 1886; ed. Berkhamstead schl.; entd. civ. serv. of Jamaica, 1909; 2nd cls. clk., 1914; 1st cls. clk., 1920; sec., Westmoreland hurricane relief commn., 1912; sec. foot and mouth disease commn., 1922; ag. priv.
sec. to gov. of Jamaica (Sir Sydney Olivier) 1912; priv. sec. and A.D.C. to gov. of Jamaica (Sir Leslie Probyn), 1920-23; prin. clk., col. secretariat, 1929; war serv., R.F.A. (France and Flanders), 1915-18; A.D.C. to C.R.A., 68th Div., 1918; W.O. staff, 1919; ed. of "The School Garden in Jamaica" and "Elementary Hygiene."

LUCKMAN, CYRIL HERBERT MORTON.—B. 1881; clk., cust., Johannesburg, 1903; 1st grade clk., Capetown, 1912; senr. clk., 1915; 2nd grade prin. clk., Pretoria, 1922; 1st grade ditto, 1926; acctnt., Pretoria, 1930; oh. clk., 1933; ch. inspr., 1933.

LUDDINGTON, NORMAN JOHN, M. Sc., Durham Univ.—B. 1888; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., 17th Nov., 1911; attd., Jaffna kach., Dec., 1911; pol. mag., Negombo, May, 1915; Panadura, June, 1915; Negombo, Aug., 1915; Galle, Apr., 1916; Colombo, July, 1921; astt. consnr., excise, July, 1923; astt. sttlm. offr., Nov., 1926; addnl. consnr., lab., Sept., 1931; gov. agt., Sabaragamuwa, July, 1933; gov. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, July, 1935.

LUGARD, 1ST BARON (cr. 1928), Rt. Hon. Sir Frederick John D'ALTRY LUGARD, P.C. (1920), G.C.M.G. (1911), K.C.M.G. (1911), C.B. (1895), D.S.O. (1887).—B. 1858; ed. Rossall and Sandhurst; 1st comnr., 9th foot, May, 1878; captain, Aug., 1880; major, Aug., 1896; lieut.-col., July, 1899; col., July, 1905; temp. brig.-gen., 1900-07; to India, Sept., 1878; active service, Afghanistan, Sept., 1879, to Sept., 1880; medal; Soudan, Feb. to Nov., 1885; medal clasp, "Tofrek" Khedive's Star, despatches Burmah, Oct., 1886, to Aug., 1887; mentioned in despatches, D.S.O. and medal. To Africa, Feb., 1888; commanding expdn. against slave traders; very severely wounded. To East Africa, Nov., 1889, to Oct., 1892; exploration of Sabakhi; adminstr. Uganda; went to Borgu in comd. expdn., July, 1894, and made treaties on behalf of Royal Niger Company, returned, Apr., 1895, Feb., 1896, led expedition across Kalahari for Brd Charterland Co.; apptd. comanr. and comdt., West African frontier force, Aug., 1897; high comanr. for Northern Nigeria, Dec., 1899; resigned Sept., 1906; gov. of Hong Kong, May, 1907; gov., N. and S. Nigeria, Mar., 1912; gov.-gen., Nigeria, Dec., 1913; assumed govt., Jan., 1914; retired, 1919; Br. mem., Permanent Mandates comnr. since 1922; author of "The Dual Mandate in Br. Tropical Africa" and other works.

LUGG, HARRY CAMP.—B. 1882; ed. Greytown; elk. and Zulu interp., mag.'s office, Bulwer, Dec., 1899; Msinga, Jan., 1901; Greytown, Feb., 1902; elk., civ. comm., Zululand, Aug., 1903; native affrs., Natal, Nov., 1903; Zulu interp. and astt. regisr., native high ct., July, 1908; sworn Zulu interp., sup. ct., Aug., 1909; sen. clk. and astt. mag., Durban, Dec., 1916; mag., Ndewede, Dec., 1918; Ingwavuma, May, 1920; Mapumulo, Aug., 1921; 2nd grade mag., Richmond, Apr., 1923; 1st grade mag., Verulam July, 1928; senr. mag., Verulam, Aug., 1930; pres., native appl. ct., Natal and Transvaal, Oct., 1932; ch. native comanr., Natal, May, 1933.

LUKE, Sir HARRY CHARLES, Kt. Bach. C.M.G. (1926), Knight of Justice of the Order of St. John of Jerusalem.—B. 1884; ed. at Eton and Trinity Coll., Oxford; 2nd cls. mod. hist., B.A., 1906; M.A., 1910; J. Litt., 1919; priv. sec. to the govt. of Sierra Leone 1908, and A.D.C., 1909; agt. astt. col. sec., Sierra Leone, Mar. to July, 1909; priv. sec. to the govt. of Barbados, Feb., 1911; attached to C.O., May to July, 1911 (Coronation medal); priv. sec. to the high comanr. of Cyprus (Sir H. Gooch-Archer, G.C.M.G.), and clk. of exec. coun., Oct., 1912; astt. sec. to govt., Cyprus, 1912; astt. sec., Paphos, 1917; comanr., Famagusta, 1918; Cyprus defence comte., Aug., 1914; H.M.S. Doris on Syrian Coast, 1914-1915; polit. offr. to Admirals Lord Wester Wemyss and Sir Ian and govt. sec., Mudros, Feb., 1915 to Feb., 1916; (lieut.-comdr., and ag. comdr., R.N.V.R.) recd. thanks of admry.; Italian med. for valour; political offr. to Admiral of the Fleet Sir J. de Robeck, Constantinople and Black Sea, Aug., 1919; Br. ch. comsnr. in Geor. Armenia and Azerbaijan, Apr. to Sept., 1920; astt. gov. of Jerusalem, Oct., 1920; comanr. on the Orthodox Patriarchate of Jerusalem, and on the Jaffa disturbances, 1921; finan. comanr. of the Patriarchate, 1921-24; sec., Sierra Leone, May, 1924; ag. sec. on occasions; ch. sec., Palestine, July, 1928; gov., Malta, Aug., 1930; passed in Turkish modern Greek (lang.); author of "A Bibliography of Sierra Leone," 1910 and 1925; "Cyprus and the Turks," 1921; joint editor, "Handbook of Cyprus," and "Handbook of Palestine and Transjordan."

LUKE, S. E. V., B.A., 1927.—B. 1905; St. George's, Harpenden and Oxford, Brasenose exhib., Wadham Coll., 1924; 2nd cls. mod., 1927; apptd. after compet. exam. astt. taxes (inland rev.), 1927; apptd. after compet. exam., junr. clk., House of Commons, Feb., 1930; transf. to C.O. as astt. sec., Sept., 1930; joint sec., col. survey com., 1931-33; visited Br. Hond. as sec. to comanr. (Sir A. Pim), 1933; astt. prte. sec., Cunliffe-Lister (now Viscount Swinton), 1934, to Mr. Malcolm MacDonald, 7th June, 1935; to Mr. J. H. Thomas, 27th Nov., 1935; sec. to Palestine admntr., 4th Jan., 1936.

LUNNON, GEORGE JOSEPH.—B. 1902; after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 4th cls. cler. offr., higher grade, 3rd Mar., 1937.

LUPPRIAN, ERNEST VICTOR, M.R.C.S.E., L.R.C.P. (Lond.), Dip. L.S.T.M.—B. 1889; Bishop Currier Gram. Schi. and St. Mary's Madras; Baldwin High Schi. and Alladiar Bangalore Univ., Madras; med. coll., St. Mary's hosp. med. schi.; L.S.T.M. med. med.; med. offr., S'pore, port health, Aug., 1920; Mlym. emigr. depots, India, July, 1923; offr., P. Wellesley, Mar., 1928 and Jan., 1930; sub-scale med. and health offr. gr. B, Feb., 1930.

LUSCOMBE, LAURENCE GEORGE.—B. 1898; ed. Hales schi., Exeter; served in S. Afr. war, 1901-02; elk., Swaziland adminstr., 1902; astt. acctnt., Dec., 1909; acctnt., 1910; finan. sec., 1918; finan. sec., Basutoland, Sept., 1927.

LYALL-GRAVETT, SIR ROBERT WILLIAM BACH, (1934), M.A. (Aberdeen, Edin.)—Vans Dunlop schol. in law, Univ.; called to Scottish bar, 1903; pract., 1909; atty.-gen., Nyasaland, Apr., 1910; judge, high ct., in 1909, 1910, 1912 and mem. Ct. of Appeal for Eastern Africa; chmn. rising comanr., 1915; chmn. of claims in Nyasaland, under Br. prots. defence O. in 1916-19; judge advoc. to Nyassaland-Rhodesia Field Force, 1917-18; atty.-gen., Kenya, 1920; mem., exec. andleg. councils; prtnr., Ceylon, Feb., 1926; ch. just., Jamaica, ret., 1936.
NCH, Francis Christopher Chisholm.—B. 1884; ed. at pub. schls., priv. tuition, McGill Univ.; assoc., Eng. Inst., Canada; assoc. mem., Planning Inst. of Canada; gen. engrnr., 1905; apptd. to interior dept., 1906; astt. rly. lands br., 1911; supt., nat. resources dept., 1912; dir. of int. Can., Dec., 1911.

ON, Malcolm Douglas.—B. 1898; ed. by and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; M.A., 1923; 2nd Lieut., R.F.A., 1916-18; called to bar, Inner Temple, 1925; S.E. circuit; pol. mag., Australia, Sept., 1932; res. mag., Tanganyika Territory, Oct., 1935.

YONS, Rt. Hon. Joseph Aloysius.—B. 1879; state and convent schls.; M.H.A., Tasmania, 1929; treas., min. for educn. and min. for res., 1914-16; premier, treas. and min. for rlys., 1924-27; premier, treas. and min. for mines, 1927-30; premier and treas., 1927-28; el. to H.R., Commonwealth of Australia, 1929; P.M.G. and min. for wks. and rlys., 1929; prime min. of the c'thch., 1932.

ABB, Capt. Victor Leopold, M.C., chevalier de la Legion d'Honneur.—B. 1889; ed. "Fort Garry" Regt. 18th Canadian Arv., Aug., 1914; served in France as com.nr., Tank Corps, Dec., 1916; left Army, July, 1920; ret. in desg.s.; admstive. serv., N. Provs., 1920; transf. prisons dept., S. Provs., 1925; updt., prisons, 1924; ag. inspr., prisons, 1925; dir., prisons, 1926; dir., prisons, S. Provs., 1926.

MACASKIE, Capt. Charles Frederick Cunningham, barrister-at-law, F.R.G.S.—B. 1888; let, N. Borneo, Aug., 1910; 1st cls. mag., Mar., 1911; on mil. ser., 1916-19 (ment. in desp.), astt. sec., Jan., 1920; legal advr. in addn., July, 1920; prot., lab., Mar., 1922; prot., lab., sec. for these affrs. and legal advr., June, 1925; res., July, 1929; judge, seas. ct., Aug., 1930; judge, high ct., Dec., 1930; O.A.G., Dec., 1930-Jan., 1931; res. and offl. mem., leg. coun., Dec., 1931; seconded as gov't. sec., Sarawak, Sept., 1932; dep. v. N. Borneo and ag. ch. just. in addn., Dec., 1934; ch. just., Oct., 1935.

McBRIDE, Andrew Howie, B.Sc., A.M. st. C.E.—B. 1900; ed. Dumbarton Acad. and Glasgow Univ.; engrnr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 1925.

MACBRIE, Maj.-Gen. Sir James Howden, C.B., C.M.G., D.S.O.—B. 1878; ed. Port Perry High Schl., Ontario; brig.-gen. comdr., 12th infy. reg. during war; ch. of gen. staff, O.M.F.C., ch. staff, dept. of national defence, Canada; msnr., R. Canadian Mounted Pol., 1931.

MACCALL, Thomas Vernon.—B. 1884; ed. Hickory's schl., Portsmouth, and Edin. Univ.; joined London Metro. Police, Feb., 1905; served C.I.D., New Scotland Yard; resig. Mar., 1911; served in B. of T. labour exchanges, June, 1911-Mar., 1914; astt. supt. of police, B. Honduras, pr., 1914; J.P., Apr., 1914; ag. dist. comsrr., Orange Walk, July-Aug., 1914; visiting just. ist. prisons, 1914-19; dep. atty.-gen., Corosel sessions, sup. ct., Sep., 1914; ag. dist. comsrr., Orange Walk, Feb.-Mar., 1915; comsrr. of sup. ct., Apr., 1915; 2nd lieut., B. H. Volm., Dec., 1915, attd., Corosel; lieut., Jan., 1917; served in Cayo Exped. Force, on Guatemalan frontier, apr. to July, 1916; capt., B.H.T.F., May, 1917; dep. atty.-gen., Corosel sessions, sup. ct., Dec., 1918; ag. dist. comsrr., Corosel from Nov., 1918.

MCCALLAN, E.A.—B. 1874; ed. Ontariot agrl. coll.; clk., post office, Bermuda, 1903; clk., works dept., 1904; rev. offr., 1907; agric. asst., 1913; dir. of agric., Bermudas 1920; del. to Washington 1920 and 1928; mem., immigr. lab. bd.

McCALLUM, Alexander.—B. 1890; ed. Daniel Stewart's Coll., Edinburgh; G.E.A. campaign, 1916-18; trooper, Tanganyika Territory pol., 1918; astt. inspr., 1919; inspr., 1920; astt. supt., 1923; supt., 1928; ag. dep. comsrr., pol. and prisons, 1931.

McCALLUM, Angus, M.C.—Ed. Geo. Watson's Coll., Edin. and Aberdeen Univ.; capt., B.E.F., France, Aug., 1915 to Aug., 1918, M.C. and bar. ment. in desp.; lieut., 3rd K.A.R., Nov., 1918 to June, 1922; dist. polit. offr., Somaliland, Sept., 1923.

McCARTER, Harry Bertram Adair, O.B.E. (1937).—B. 1883; entd. civil serv., Cape Col., 1899; served S. African war in Fingoland native levies, 1901-02; law dept., Transvaal civil serv., 1902; clk., Swaziland adminstr., June, 1907; clk. and dep. astt. comsrr., Apr., 1911; passed Cape Univ. civ. serv. lower law exam., 1911; astt. comsrr., 1928; ag. dep. res. comsrr., Mar.-Sept., 1935; dep. res. comsrr., Oct., 1935.

McCarthy, Dennis Douglas, M.B., Ch.B., D.T.M. and H. (Lond.), certif., L.S.T.M.—B. 1899; ed. Otago Univ., N.Z. and Otago Med. Schl.; med. offr., rural med. serv., Tokanui, N.Z., 1924-27; med. offr., Zanzibar, Mar., 1927; malaria research offr., 1934.

McCarthy, Leslie Ernest Vivian, B.A.—B. 1885; ed. Keble Coll., Oxford; 2nd cls. hon. final jurisprudence; barrister-at-law, Gray's Inn, 1911; crown counsel, Gold Coast, Sept., 1921; ag. solr.-gen. for various periods, 1922-33; extraordinary mem., leg. coun., Feb., 1930; ag. circ. judge, Ashanti and N.T., Oct., 1931 to Feb., 1932; solr.-gen., 1933; ag. puisne judge, Apr. and Nov., 1933; ag. atty.-gen. in Jan. and Apr., 1934 and Mar.-Sept., 1936; revising comsrr., Gold Coast Laws, Sept., 1935.

McCleland, Reginald Hugh, L.C.E. (Dub.)—B. 1884; ed. Penang Free Schl. and Trinity Coll. Dublin; engrnr., survr., S.S., May, 1908; lent to Kedah, Nov., 1909; astt. engrnr., Aug., 1918; exec. engrnr., Dec., 1923; dep. col. engrnr., in addn., Mar.-May, 1927 and Oct.-Nov., 1927; senr. exec. engrnr., Penang and P. Wellesley, Apr., 1931.

McConnechy, Fergus Malcolm Graham, B.Sc., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1890; ed. Seavoe's Grammar Schl. and Manchester Univ.; astt. engrnr., P.W.D., F.M.S., Apr., 1914; exec. engrnr., 1922; senr. exec. engrnr., 1929; ag. dep. dir. pub. works, S.S., Apr. to Dec., 1932 and July-Nov., 1934.

McCormick, Alexander.—B. 1892; astt. clk., G.P.O., London, 1912; 2nd divn. clk., accountants office, G.P.O., Dublin, 1914; astt. acct., G.P.O., Lagos, 1926; survr. and ag. cin. acct., for various periods until apptd. col. postmr., Gibraltar, July, 1930.

McCormick, Spencer Acklon.—B. 1878; ed. Komga Pub. Schl. and pte. tuition; joined Cape civ. serv., 1896; native affrs. dept., Transvaal, Feb., 1897, and served in Tembuland and Transkei transf. to head office Cape Town, 1900; astt. mag., Lichtenburg, June, 1901; transf. to various country stations between 1902 and 1906; stationed Joliansannes as 2nd civ. mag., 1907; civ. mag., Pretoria, Aug., 1908; ch. mag., Pretoria, May, 1924; under-sec. for just., 1929; judge, native high ct., Pietermaritzburg, Apr., 1930.
McCOWAN, HUGH WALLACE.—B. 1885; ed. Queen's Coll., B. MARTYN, ELDER BRIDGEMAN, B.A., A.I.C.T.A.—B. 1903; ed. Marlborough Coll., Oriel Coll., Oxford and Imp. Col. Sci. & Tech.; C.O. scholarship courses in mycology, Emmanuel Coll., Cambridge, and Imp. Col. Trop. Agr., Trinidad; botanist mycologist, dept. agr., Br. Guiana, 1928.

MARWICK, ALLAN GRAHAM, O.B.E. (1925).—B. 1877; served in Natal div. serv., 1895 to 1899; served Anglo-Boer war, 1899-1901; sub. native comsnr., Mbabane, Swaziland, Jan., 1903 to Mar., 1907; asst. comsnr., ditto, Mar., 1907; asst. comsnr., Hlatikulu, Swaziland, Aug., 1916; mem. Swaziland-Portuguese bdry. coman., 1920; asst. comsnr., Mbabane and ag. dep. res. coman., Oct., 1932; dep. res. comsnr., 1933; res. comsnr., 1935.

MASON, GERALD BOYELL.—Ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados; matric., London Univ., 1890; joined London hosp., 1890; passed prelim. scientific, 1892; M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), 1896, certif., London Schi. of Trop. Med., 1909; D.P.H., Cambridge, 1917; med. offr., No. 4 dist., Antigua, 1903; ag. comsnr., Virgin Is., 1904; surg. lieut., Antigua def. force, 1904; mag. and med. offr., Anguilla and dep. judge of sup. et., Leeward Is., Jan., 1905 to Sept., 1906; med. offr., No. 6 dist., Nevis, 1906; med. offr., dist. “D”, and mag. dist. “F”, Dominica, 1907; med. offr., St. Vincent, 1909-12; temp. aspt., R.A.M.C.; med. offr. in charge of troops, Cambridge, 1916-19; founder and hon. sec., W. Indian Club, 1897-8; founder and hon. sec., West India Red Cross Socy., 1921-1924; dir., med. and health dept., Bermuda, Aug., 1924.

MASON, HON. HENRY GREATHEAD REX, M.A., LL.B. (N.Z.).—B. 1885; ed. Clyde Quay Schi., Wellington Coll. and Victoria Univ. Coll., N.Z.; mem., N.Z. H. of R. since 1926; atty.—gen. and min. of just., 1935.

MASSIE, HON. VINCENT.—B. 1887; ed. St. Andrew’s Coll., Toronto, Univ. of Toronto and Balliol Coll., Oxford, (M.A.); lect., mod. hist., Univ. of Toronto, 1913-15; in ch. musketry, mil. dist. No. 2 (Canada), 1915-18 (ment.); temp. lieut. col., 1916; assoc. sec., war comittee of cabinet (Ottawa), Jan.-Dec., 1918; sec., govt. repatriation comittee, and later dir., 1918-19; minr. without portfolio in Dominion cabinet, 1925; attended Imp. Conf., London, 1926; H.M. envoy extraordinary and min. plenipotentiary for Canada to U.S.A., 1926-30; high comsnr. for Canada in London, 1930.

MASSON, GERALD GUSTAVE—B. 1888; dipl. of agr., Roseworthy Agr. Coll., S. Australia; served in Great War with 9th Australian Light Horse Regt., 1915-19; Gallipoli, Sinai, Palestine and Syria; ment. in desps.; inspr., agr., occupied enemy territory adminstr., 1919; inspr., agr., N. Palestine, 1920; inspr., agr. and forests, 1924; ch. agr. offr., 1930; sec., comittee of agronomy, gen. agr. coun., Palestine.

MASTERTON-SMITH, SIR JAMES EDWARD, K.O.B. (1919), C.B. (1915).—B. 1878; ed. Harrow (schol.) and Hartford Coll., Oxford (schol.); ent. home civ. serv. (cls. L.), admity., 1901; priv. sec. to 2nd sea. lord, 1904-8; priv. sec. to perm. sec., 1908-10; priv. sec. to successive 1st lords of the admity., 1910-17; asst. sec., min. of munitions, Sep., 1917 to Jan., 1919; asst. sec. (adm.), W.O. and Air Min., 1919-20; joint perm. sec., miny. of labour, 1920; perm. under-sea. of state for the colonies, 30th Aug., 1921; sec. to the Order of St. Michael and St. George; mem. of the offi. side of the National Whitley Coun.; ret., 1925; Offr. of the Belgian Order of the Crown.

MASTERTON-SMITH, PERCY FRANK, M.C.—B. 1896; ed. Christ’s Hosp. and Wadham Coll., Oxford (hons. med. hist.); B.A., 1921; R. Fusiliers, 1914-16; 60th Rifles, 1916-19; M.C., 1917; capt., res. of Offrs., 60th Rifles; admin. offr., Nigeria, 25th Jan., 1922.

MATEER, EDWARD JOHN.—Ed. Foyle Coll. and Taunton Schi.; asst. treas., Uganda, July 1920; senr. asmt. treas., 1931; prim. asmt. treas., 1935.

MATHER, NORMAN FREDERICK HUGH, B.A., (Oxon).—B. 1890; ed. Merchant Taylor’s Schi., and Hartford Coll., Oxford (schol.); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1913; served in Rifle Brig. Dec., 1915-Sept., 1919; asst. sec. to res. Selangor, Nov., 1919; asst. dist. offr., May, 1921; registr., war serv. land grant scheme, S. Feb., 1922; sec. to res., Pahang, Dec., 1923; mag., Seremban, July, 1925; offr., cls. III, Nov., 1925; chmn., sany. bd., Seremban, Aug., 1926; cls. II, Nov., 1930; asst. advr., Segamat, May, 1928; dist. offr., Larut and regitr., teles., Perak, Mar., 1932; chmn., govt. rice mill in addn., May, 1933; ag. comsnr., trade and cust., Johore, Sept., 1935.

MATHERS, FREDERICK FRANCIS, K.C., LL.B.—B. 1871; ed. schla. in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Dalhousie law schl. and Harvard law schl.; called to the bar, 1892; dep. prov. sec. and clk. of exec. coun., N.S., 1902; also regitr. of joint stock companies, 1909; now deputy atty.-gen.

MATHESON, CAPT. C. L. T., M.C.—Commissioned in Royal Engineers, 1909; asst. dir. of surv., G. Coast, 1914; Togoland campaign, 1914; Cameroon, 1914-15; France with Field Coy. R.E., 1916-17; W.O., 1918; dep. dir. topographical surveys, G. Coast, 1920.

MATHEW, CHARLES.—B. 1903; ed. Downside schl. and Trinity Coll., Oxford; barrister-at-law, Lincoln’s Inn, 1927; cadet, admin. Nigeria, 1929; asst. dist. offr., 1932; ag. pol. mag., crown coun., and offi. admtr. on various occasions, 1930-33; mag., Uganda, 1933; ag. mag., Palestine, but did not proceed; crown coun., Uganda, 1936; ag. solr.-gen., Nov., 1935-Dec., 1936.

MATHEWS, ARNOLD BURNETT.—B. 1889; ed. Shrewsbury (schl.) and Magdalene Coll., Cambridge (cls. schl.); sub-lieut., R.N.V.R., 1917; 2nd cls., Pt. I, classical tripes, 1920; M. 2nd cls., anthropological tripes, 1922; asst. d. offr., N.P. Nigeria, Jan., 1923; asst. sec., N. secretariat, Feb., 1925; asst. sec., Nig. secretariat, Aug., 1927; clk. to exec. and couns., Apr.-Sept., 1928; stdt., C.O., July, 1929; asst. sec., Nigerian secret., Sept., 1929; dist. offr., N. Prov., Aug., 1930; dist. offr., 1931; sp. duty reorganization pagan admtr.
DOMINIONS OFFICE AND COLONIAL OFFICE LIST

1933-35; ch. asst. col. sec., Sierra Leone, July, 1935; ag. col. sec., May-Oct., 1936; gov't. dep. on several occasions.

MATHIESON, Hon. John Alexander, K.C.—B. 1863; ed. Harrington Gram. Sch., Prince of Wales' Coll., Taught Sch., Desable Gram. Sch., P.E.I., read law with McLean and Macdonald; called to the P.E.I. bar, 1893; K.C., 1903; el. to legislature for King's county, 1900; re-el., 1904, 1908 and 1912; leader of the opposition, 1903; premier and atty.-gen., 2nd Dec., 1911; ch. just., P.E.I., 13th June, 1917.

MATHIESON, Joseph George, B.L. (Glasgow)—B. 1907; ast. admstr. gen., Zanzibar, 1930; ag. munici. and land offr., Apr., 1934; munici. and land offr., Sept., 1934; ag. admstr. gen., pub. trustee, regis. docs. in addn., Apr., 1935; ast. admstr. gen. and dep. offr. rec., Uganda, 1936.

MATTHEWS, Ernest Lewis, K.C., C.M.G. (1914).—Called to the bar, Inner Temple; law adviser to Transvaal govt., June, 1902; law adviser to govt. of Union of S. Africa, 31st May, 1910; puisne judge, Natal prov. divn., 1926.

MATTHEWS, Leslie Gadd.—Ed. Plymouth. Oxford Univ. O.T.C., 1915; O.A.S., France, 1916 and 1917, Lanc. Fusiliers; Mesopotamia, 1917-21, attd., Indian Army and Iraq Levies; Arab rebellion, Iraq, 1920 (med. and clasp); astt. treas., Somaliland, June, 1921; dist. pol. offr., Somaliland, Feb., 1923; ast. commr., pol., Nigeria, 1926.

MAUDE, Henry Evans.—B. 1906; ed. Highgate Schl. and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; B.A., 1929; M.A., 1933; cadet, Gilbert and Ellice Is., 1929; dep. commr., 1931; ag. native lands commr., 1931; admstr. offr., 1932; ag. sec. to govt., Mar.-June, 1933; nat. lands commr., Gilbert Is., 1933; rep. Gilbert & Ellice Is. at confce. and seminar on educn. in Pacific countries, Honolulu, July-Aug., 1936; ast. dist. offr., Zanzibar, Sept., 1936.

MAULE, John Patrick.—B. 1906; ed. Berkhamsted schl. and Sidney Sussex coll., Cambridge; M.A., 1932; dipl., agr., 1929; A.I.C.T.A. (Trinidad), 1930; astt., agr., Nigeria, 1930; man., govt. stock farm, Cyprus, 1934.

MAYROGORDATO, Col. Arthur Stephen, O.B.E. (1928).—B. 1886; ed. at Oakham Schl., Rutland; clk., pol. headqrs., Cyprus, Nov., 1903; inspr., mil. pol., Cyprus, May, 1905; in ch. pol. detachment, Kyrena, 1907-1909; gov't., prison and dep. coroner; in command of Papho dist. several occasions; detailed for sp. duty in Larnaca dist. in connection with Limassol riots, May-June, 1912; ast. commr., pol., Sierra Leone, June, 1913; J.P. and dep. coroner, 1913; ag. commr., pol., also sheriff, prison visiting just. and gov't. nominee on city coun. of Freetown, and performing duties of marshal of the Adny. prize ct., on various occasions, 1916-18; ag. harbmr. and detaining offr. under mil. authorities, in 1916, 1917, 1918 and 1919; ag. dist. commr. in headqrs. dist., S. Leone, Feb.-Mar., 1919; dep. inspr.-gen., pol. and prisons, Palestine, Dec., 1922; ag. inspr.-gen., pol. and prisons, Apr., 1924; commit., ditto, Apr., 1926; rep. Palestine govt. at internat. pol. confce., Antwerp, Sept., 1930; inspr.-gen., constab., Trinidad, July, 1931; mem., leg. coun.; awarded King's Pol. med., 1934.

MAXWELL, Sir Wm. George, K.B.E. (1924), C.M.G. (1915); Royal Humane Society's med. (1882).—B. 1871; ed. at Clifton Coll.; barrister-at-law, Inner Temp.; jun. offr., Perak, F.M.S., Mar., 1891 ast. mag., Kinta, Apr., 1892; registr. of cts., Kinta, Perak, Feb., 1899; dist. offr., Dindings, Aug., 1900; dep. pub. pros., Singapore, 1906; sol.-gen., S. Settmts., Aug., 1906; British adviser to govt. of Kedah, July, 1909; ag. col. sec., S. Stiltns., 1914; ag. sec. to high commr., Malay States and Brunei, 1915; ag. British res., Perak, Dec., 1916 to May, 1917; ag. sec. to high commr., Malay States and Brunei, June, 1917; vice-chmn., food control comtees., S.S. and F.M.S.; vice-chmn., shipping control comtees., S.S.; pres., rubber commr., 1918; pres., Singapore housing commr.; pres., Singapore centenary comte.; general adviser to govt., Johore, June, 1918; ag. col. sec., S. Stiltns., Dec., 1918; Br. res., Perak, Dec., 1919; ch. sec. to govt., F.M.S., Sept., 1920; ret., 1926; publications, "Perak Land Laws (past and present)," "The Laws of Perak, 1877-1903;" "The Laws of the S. Stiltns., 1827-1907;" "In Malay Forests."

MAXWELL-ANDERSON, Sir Maxwell Hendry.—Kt. Bach. (1934), C.B.E. (1919); O.B.E. (1918); K.C., Aug., 1919; capt., R.N. (ret.).—Ent. Royal Navy, 1893; ret. at own request, 1912; recd. thanks of Admy. for series of magnetic observations carried out in the Pacific Ocean; inst., R.N. Coll., Portsmouth, 1908-10; called to bar, Middle Temple, 1909; younger brother of Trinity House, 1910; rejoined Navy on outbreak of war; promoted capt., Apr., 1919; govt. mem., central (unemployed) body for London, 1913 to 1919; astt.-gen., Gibraltar, May, 1919; ag. chief just., and col. sec. on several occasions; ch. just., Fiji and judl. commr., W. Pacific, 1929; ag. high commr., W. Pacific, June to Aug., 1930; ret., 1936.

MAY, Henry O'Hara, M.D., B.Ch., B.A.O. (Univ. Dubl.), D.P.H. (Irel.).—B. 1878; med. offr., W.A.M.S., Apr., 1907; med. offr., health, Nov., 1911; junr. sanry. offr., Aug., 1916; dep. dir., sanry. serv., Sierra Leone, Oct., 1922; dep. dir., health serv., Gold Coast, June, 1926.

MAY, Thomas William Vivian, A.R.I.B.A., M.I.Struct.E., archt.—B. 1889; ast. in prim. archt.'s dept. of H.M.O.W., 1909-14; war serv., Aug., 1914; Aug., 1919; ast. archt., Spore, Harbr. Bd., Nov., 1919; ast. archt., P.W.D., May, 1924; ast. archt., Spore, July, 1933; state archt., Johore, Mar., 1934.

MAYBIN, John Alexander, C.M.G. (1935).—B. 1889; M.A. (Edin.); cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Jan., 1914; attached to the Badulla kach, Jan., 1914; ag. office astt. to govt. agt., July, 1914, and Jan., 1915; addtl. dist. judge and pol. mag., Badulla in addn. June, 1915; pol. mag., Panadura, Mar., 1916; on mil'y. duty, 1917; ag. pol. mag., Kandy, July, 1919; 2nd finan. astt. to chmn., mun. coun., Colombo, Mar., 1920; finan. astt., Colombo Municipality, Nov., 1920; addnl. ast. col. sec., Jan., 1922; landing survr., Colombo cust., Mar., 1923; 3rd ast. col. sec., Feb., 1924; 2nd ast. col. sec. and clk., leg. coun., Mar., 1925; ast. regiar., co-op. socs., Apr., 1928; dep. regiar., co-op. socs., Sept., 1932; ch. sec., Nigeria, 1934; O.A.G., Dec., 1934 and June-Oct., 1935.

MAYHEW, Arthur Innes, C.M.G. (1936), C.I.E.—B. 1878; ed. at Winchester and New Coll., Oxford (schl.); B.A., 1901; Berlin and Jena Univs. ent. Indian educn. serv., 1903; educn. adviser, Hyderbad State, 1910; dir., pub. instrn., Cent. Prove, 1913; ag. educn. commr. to govt. of India, 1921; mem., Eton Coll. staff, 1922-29; joint sec. to advisory comte. on educn. in the
C.O., 1929; author of "The Education of India," "Christianity and the Government of India."

MAYLE, NORMAN LESLIE.—B. 1899; apptd. after compet. exam., ast. clk., C.O., Oct., 1917; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920; promoted to clk. of the 2nd div., Feb., 1920; on mil serv. from Sept., 1917 to Sept., 1919; cler. offr., higher grade, 7th July, 1923; ast. prin., 16th Nov., 1928; ag. pvt. sec. to parl. U.S. of S. for the Cola., 2nd Feb., 1932; pvt. sec., do., 18th Apr., 1932; ag. prin., 1st Jan., 1936.

MAYNARD, PRYCE.—B. 1903; apptd. after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 15th Oct., 1920; cler. offr., higher grade, 3rd Mar., 1937.

MEAD, JOHN PHILLIPS.—B. 1886; dip. forestry (Oxon); ed. Charterhouse Sch.; Royal Indian Engrg. Coll. (Coopers Hill) and Exeter Coll., Oxford; ast. cons. forests and ag. dep. cons. forests, Aug., 1907-May, 1916; on mil serv. 1916-19; inspr., forests Kordofan prov., Soudan, Aug., 1918; conserv., forests, Sarawak, 1919; temp. forestry advr. to govt., Fiji, Nov., 1926; ast. cons., forests, F.M.S., Jan., 1928; dep. cons. forests, F.M.S., March, 1928; dir., forestry, F.M.S. and S.S., Jan., 1930.

MEADE, CHARLES RICHARD.—Copyist, treasy. and post office dept., Montserrat, Oct., 1907; 5th clk., Apr., 1912; 4th clk., Nov., 1912; gov't. offr., Sandy Point, St. Kitts-Nevis, Nov., 1915; clk., treasy., Virgin Is., May, 1917; clk., exec. council; prin., Apr., 1927; prin., treasy., Dominica, Dec., 1928; ag. treasy., mem. exec. and leg. couns. and chmn., commrs. of income tax in 1931 and 1932; ast. treasy. and postmtr., Montserrat, Dec., 1933.

MEADE, CAPT. JOSEPH MICHAEL, B.A. (T.C.D.). Barrister-at-Law (King's Inns, Dublin).—B. 1889; European mast., S.S. and F.M.S., Dec., 1920; ast. mast., King Edward VII schl., Taiping, Feb., 1921; ast. inspr., schls., Perak, Jan., 1923, Sept., 1925 and Apr., 1929; inspr., schls., N. Sembilan, Jan., 1926; ast. inspr., schls., Spore, Oct., 1930; ag. inspr., schls., Malacca, Jan. 1931; senr. educn. offr. (E), Nov., 1931; ag. supt., educn., Johore, Jan., 1934.

MEADEN, HENRY, M.B.E. (1931).—B. 1882; ast. warden, Tobago, 1919; ast. warden, St. Patrick, 1922; mag. warden, Tobago, 1st Apr., 1926.

MEARNS, JOHN WILLIAM, B.Sc. (Engng.), Glasgow, A.M.I.Struct.E., A.M.I.C.E.—B.1894; ast. engr., sea defences, Br. Guiana, 1920; do., pub. wks. dept., 1922; dist. engr., 1926.

MEDWAY, F. W.—Imp. serv. (acctnt-gen.'s dept., G.P.O.), 1901-2; clk., G.P.O., Bloemfontein, Nov., 1902; clk., treasy., O.F.S., May, 1908; senr. clk., treasy., Union of S. Africa, Apr., 1912; senr. clk., inland rev. dept., Dec., 1916; prin. clk., Apr., 1917; oh. clk., April, 1928; recr., Pietermaritzburg, Apr., 1933.

MEEK, A. I., L.R.C.P., L.R.C.S., D.P.H. (Edin.), L.R.F.P. & S. (Glas.).—B. 1889; R.A.M.C., Aug., 1918 to May, 1920; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, May, 1922; senr. health offr., Apr., 1930.

MEGARRY, THOMAS, B.A.—B. 1898; ed. Royal Academical Inst., Belfast and Trinity Coll., Dublin; B.A. (1st cl. hons., classics and mental and moral philosophy); cadet, Hong Kong, Nov., 1922; passed cadet, Dec., 1924; ast. to sec., Chinese affrs., 1925; ast. head, sany. dept., Mar., 1928; 3rd ast. col. sec., June, 1928; sec., currency comttee, in addn., 1930; mag. and dist. offr., N. district, New Territories, Mar., 1931; head sany. dept. and pres., sany. bd., Jan., 1933; dist. N. dist., New Territories, Jan., 1934.

MEGAW, ARTHUR HUBERT STANLEY, M. (Cantab.).—B. 1910; ed. Campbell coll., Puke and Peterhouse, Cambridge; Walstoned, 1913; ast. dir., Br. schl. of archaeology, Athens, Oct., 1935; ag. dir., May, 1936; dir. antiquities, Cyprus, July, 1936.

MEGSON, JOHN.—B. 1895; apptd. dir. compet. exam. clk. of the 2nd div. of the civil service temporarily assigned to Board of Agric., Jul., 1919; Home Office, Aug., 1914; on military serv., Nov., 1916 to Mar., 1919; Home Office, May-Apr., 1919; assigned to C.O., Apl., 1919; elec. higher grade, 9th Jan., 1923; staff offr., Oct., 1930.

MEIGHEN, Rt. Hon. ARTHUR P.C., K.C.B. 1874; ed. St. Mary's Coll. Inst. and Torr. Univ.; B.A., 1896; Ist. at H. of C., Can., g.e., 1908; re-el., 1911, 1913 and 1917; defe., 1921; el. by-el., 1922; re-el., 1926; sol., 1913; re-el. acl., 1913; p.c. (Can.), 1915; min. of state and min. of mines (Can.), 1917; last name year, min. of interior and sup. gen. affrs.; prime min. of Canada, 1920; p.c. (E.), 1920; prime min., Can., 1928; del., 1927; min. senate, 1932; min. without portfolio in Ben cabinet and govt. leader in senate, 1933; less of oppsn., senate, 1935.

MELLISH, HON. HUMPHREY.—B. 1882; Mount Mellick Schl., Prince of Wales Rd., Charlottetown, 1876-79 (holder of Govt. scholarship for County of Queen's P.E.I., 1878; medallist, classics and maths, 1879); Dalhousie Univ., A.B., 1882, LL.B.; matriculant, Univ. Lond., hons. div., 1883; called to N.S. bar, K.C., 1904; practised law, 1891-1918; N.S. Barristers' Soc., 1912-13; agt. comm. min. of just. in N.S., 1903-04; judge, N.S., 1918, also surrogate, and dep. loco. adm., for N.S. dist., 1920; local polit. adm., 1921.

MELVILLE, EUGENE.—B. 1911; ed. Queen Park Schl., Glasgow and United Coll., St. Andrews; Harkness res. schol., 1929-33; ast. hons. classics, 1933; 1st cl. hons. econ. and moral philosophy, 1935; ast. inspr., treasy., apptd., after compet. exam., ast. prin., C., Jan., 1936.

MENZIES, Rt. Hon. ROBERT G. P.C. (1937), K.C., LL.M., M.P., M.I.C. V., 1928-32; min. without portfolio, 1928-29; min. for Nunawading, Victoria, 1932-34; ast. min. for rly. and dep. premier; sl. M.H. C'wealth of Australia for Kooyong (Vic.), atty.-gen. and min. for industry, Lyons, 1934.

MERCIECA, PROF. SIR STEPHEN ARTHUR Bach, (1926), M.A., L.L.D.—B. 1878; Malta Univ., 1894; M.A., 1897; LL.D., 1915; ast. of coun. of govt., 1907-10; ast. crown adv., 1915; prof. of law, 1915; crown advocate, judge, 1921; ch. just., 1924; ex. in law, 1926.

MEREWETHER, SIR EDWARD K.C.M.G.(1916); K.C.V.O.(1907); C.V.O. (1902); B.1858; ed. Harrow; ca., Oct., 1880; confirmed, Jan., 1883; Malta, with H.M.S. "Pegasus" to Tenom in c., with the "Nisero" case, Tenom in c., Dindings, 1886; 2nd ast. col. sec., jun., 1891; ast. col. sec., jun., 1891; ast. coll. of land rev., and in charge of Malacca, July, 1892; inspr. of prisons, ast. coll. sec. and clk. of couns., May, 1892; res., Selangor, Dec., 1901; lieut.-gov.,
DOMINIONS OFFICE AND COLONIAL OFFICE LIST.

MIDDEBROOK, STANLEY MUSGRAVE.—B. 1898; ed. Bradford Gram. Sch., and St. Catharine's Coll., Camb. (open exhibn., mod. history); war serv., 1917-19; cadet, S.S. Apr., 1921; offr., cls. V., Apr., 1924; asst. audr., Chinese, Nov., 1924; admst., gov't. monops. dept., S'pore, Nov., 1927; offr., cls. IV., Apr., 1928; asst. prot., Chinese, Selangor and Pahang; do., Muar, Apr., 1931; asst. to sec. for Chinese affrs., F.M.S., July, 1932; sec., uniform licences and fees commt., (road and rail transport, Malaya), Aug., 1932; offr., cls. III., Apr., 1933, asst. prot., Chinese, S'pore; asst. dir., educn., Chinese schls., F.M.S., Aug., 1934; prot., Chinese, Johore, Oct., 1936.

MIDDLETON, I. C., M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.), D.T.M., D.T.H. (Liv.)—B. 1899; mily. serv., 1917-18; med. offr., Tanganyika Territory, June, 1929.

MIDDLETON, SIR JOHN, K.C.M.G. (1931), K.B.E. (1924). O.M.G. (1916).—B. 1870; ed. Sedburgh and Univ. of Edin.; M.A.; asst. dist. comntr., S. Nigeria, 1901; ag. dist. comntr., Warri, 1901; asst. sec., 1902; sen. asst. sec., 1904; officiated as sec. to gov't. and divisional comntr., 1904-5; dist. comntr., 2nd grade, 1906; ag. ch. asst. col. sec. and asst. prov. comntr., 1906-7; senr. asst. sec., 1907; asst. col. sec., Mauritius, 1908; ag. col. sec., 1908-9; 10-11-12-13; col. sec., 1913; admstd. gov't., 1914, 1916 and 1919; gov't., Falkland Is., 1920; gov't., Gambia, 1927; gov't., Newfoundland, Sept., 1928; ret., 1932.

MIDDLETON, HON. WM. EDWARD.—B. 1860; ed. Toronto Coll. Inst. and Toronto Univ.; admitted solr., 1884; called to the bar, 1815; K.C., 1908; judge of high ct., Ontario, 1910.

MIFSUD, EDWARD R., C.M.G. (1932), O.B.E. (1927), M.B.E. (1925).—B. 1875; clk., Malta civ. serv. after compet. exam., 1892; clk., audit office, 1822; secretariat, 1901; ch. clk., lieut. gov't.'s office, 1913; dep. asst. sec. to gov't. and clk. of couns., 1920; clk. of exec., nominated, and privy couns. and private sec. to gov', Oct., 1921; sec., Maltese Imp. Gov't., June, 1927; sec. to gov't., 1932.

MIFSUD, HON. SIR UGO P., KT. BACH (1927), LL.D. (1910), B. Litt. (1906), M.L.A.—B. 1889; matric., Malta Univ., 1903; called to bar, 1910; el. to rep. first dist. in Maltese parlmt., Oct., 1921, in June, 1924 and Aug., 1927; min. of industry and commerce, 28th Oct., 1921; prime min., Aug., 1924; leader of House, 1921-23 and from 1924-27; leader of opposition and head of national party, Aug., 1927 and June 1932; prime min., 1932-1933.

MILES, ARCHIBALD CLARENCE.—B. 1887; ent. Gold Coast serv., Feb., 1909; left, May, 1919; visited W. Indies to study cocoa cultivation, 1914; rejoined Gold Coast serv., as prov. supt. of agr., July, 1921; del., Imp. agrl. confce., Oct., 1927; dep. dir., agr., Nov., 1933.

MILLAR, WILLIAM, H.E. (Irel.), A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1887; mily. serv., 1916-19 (ment. in despe.), Gold Coast, 1920; irrign. engnr., Iraq, 1922; anti-malarial engrnr., Tanganyika Territory, 1932.

MILLARD, ALFRED SUTTON, B.Sc., M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.); D.P.H.—Med. offr., S. MOTTISTONE, 1st Baron (cr. 1933), MAJOR-GEN. RT. HON. JOHN EDWARD BERNARD SEELY, P.C. (1909), C.B. (1916), C.M.G. (1918), D.S.O. (1900).—Ed. at Harrow and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1897; lieut.-col. commdg. Hampshire Carabiniers; served with Imperial Yeomanry in S. Africa, 1900-1901 (desig., Queen's medal, five clasps, D.S.O.); M.P. for Isle of Wight, 1900-06; M.P. for Aberconwy div., Liverpool, 1906-1910; M.P., Ilkeston div., Derbyshire, 1910; recd. gold medal (French gov.) for saving life at sea, 1891; parly. under-sec. of state for the colonies, 1905; chmn. of comtee. to inquire into organisation of crown agents office, 1908; under-sec. of state for war, 1911; sec. of state for war, 1912-14; joint parly. sec. to ministry of munitions, 1918; under-sec. of state for air, Jan., 1919.

MOUBRAY, GEORGE ALEXANDER DE CHAZAL DE.—B. 1888; ed. Loretto Schl., Manchester Univ. (civil engnr.), Zurich Polytechnikum and Univ. (pure science); cadet, F.M.S., 1912; offr. cls. V, Jan., 1916; do., cls. IV, Dec., 1919; ag. priv. sec. to ch. sec., F.M.S., Aug., 1920; regisr., titles and town planning admstr., Selangor, in addn., July, 1923; offr., cls. III, Dec., 1924; offr., cls. II, Dec., 1929; 1st mag., K. Lumpur, Aug., 1930; offr., cls. I B, dist. offr., L. Perak, Oct., 1933; do., Kinta, Feb., 1934; do., Lower Perak, Nov., 1934.

MOUNTAIN, HAROLD GRIFFITHS, M. Inst., M.M.—B. 1887; ed. at King's Schl., Worcester, and Schl. of Mines, Camborne (1st cls. dip.); served R.E., tunnelling coys. and eng. stores dept., 1916-19; inspr., mines, Cyprus, Oct., 1925; ag. water engnr., July-Oct., 1930; inspr., lab. and regisr., trade unions, Jan., 1933; sec. for mines, Gold Coast, 1934.

MUCHMORE, ALFRED, A.L.A.A.—B. 1893; Br. postal serv., 1912-1920; Civ. Serv. Rifles and R.A.F., 1914-19; acot., post and tels., Tanganyika territory, 1920; ast. treas., 1923; senr. ast. treas., 1931; ag. dep. treas., for various periods, 1933-36; finance offr., Aden, 1936.

MUIR, JOHN COCHRAN.—B. 1902; ed. Kilbarchan, Campbell & Allan Glens schls., Glasgow Univ. and West of Scotland Agrl. Coll.; B.Sc., (Agr.) N.D.A., N.D.D., post-grad. course, Imp. Coll. of Trop. Agr., Trinidad; ast. supt., agr.,
Gold Coast, 1925; senr. agrl. offr., Zanzibar, 1935.

MULHALL, JOHN ARCHIBALD.—B. 1899; on mily. serv., 1916; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1921; attd. Kalutara kach., Jan., 1922; ditto, Puttalam kach., Nov., 1922; extra office ast., Badulla kach., Oct., 1923; office ast., ditto, Jan., 1924; office ast., Galle kach., June, 1925; ditto, Anuradhapura kach., May, 1927; addnl. ast. col. sec., Jan., 1928; ast. col. sec., May, 1928; sec. retrenchment commn., Apr., 1932; ast. ch. sec., Oct., 1933.

MULLER, JAN FREDERIK.—B. 1891; 3rd grade clk., dept. of agr., Union of S. Africa, 1909; 2nd grade clk., 1919; 1st grade clk., 1921; senr. clk., 1926; prin. clk., dept. of mines, 1928; 2nd grade ch. clk., do., 1932; 1st grade ch. clk., do., 1934; under sec., do., 1934.

MULLIN, JOHN, O.B.E. (1935), F.S.I.—B. 1878; ed. England and Wales; assayer, surveyor and mining engr.; mem., instit. of mining and metallurgy, England; cert. sworn land surv., B. Guiana, 1906; 3rd cls. offr. and surv., B. Guiana, 1908; warden, mining dist. and J.P., 1910; 1st cls. clk., dept. of lands and mines, 1911; ag. chief clk., 1911-12, 1913-14; 1st lieut., B. Guiana local forces, 1915; capt., 1918; seconded to govt. secretariat as conf. clk., 1916; chmn., canals polder, 1917-25; ch. clk., lands and mines dept., 1918; ch. clk. and ag. ast. D.P.W., 1919-20; ast. commr., lands and mines, 1922; mem. and sec., bd. of colonisation and development, 1926; ag. commr., lands and mines, chmn., local govt. bd. and mem., town council on various occasions; commr., land and mines, 1927; mem., exec. and leg. couns., 1929.

MULOCK, Rt. Hon. Sir WILLIAM, P.C. (1925), K.C.M.G. (1902), K.C., LL.D., M.A.—B. 1843; graduated at Toronto Univ., 1863; gold medal in modern languages; called to the Ontario bar, 1868; vice-chanc. of Toronto Univ. in 1881; ast. in parl. 1882 to 1905, representing N. York; postmtr.-gen. in Sir W. Laurier's govt., June, 1896; ch. just., exchequer div., high ct. of just., Ontario, 1905; ch. just., Ontario, 1923; ret., 1936.

MUNRO, THOMAS AMBROSE VESPER.—B. 1883; harbmr., Bahamas, 1st Sept., 1913; ag. marshal, admv. side, sup. ct., 1919.

MURDOCH, JAMES WILSON, M.B., Ch.B. (Aberdeen).—B. 1900; 2nd ast. med. supt., ment. hosp., T. Rambutan, F.M.S., Jan., 1928; med. supt., do., July, 1931.

MURISON, Sir James William, KT, B.A. (1919), B.A., LL.B., K.C.—B. 1872; ed. privately and at Trin. Hall, Camb.; senr. class. scholr., 1891; 1st div., 2nd cls. class. tripes, 1894; 3rd cls. law tripes, Part II., 1895; Latham English prize, 1895; B.A., LL.B., 1895; called to Bar, Middle Temple, Apr., 1896; devilled and practised at the Chancery Bar, 1896-1902; regisr., E.A.P., Oct., 1902; town mag., Mombasa, Jan., 1904; 2nd ast. judge, H.B.M. ct. for Zanzibar, Apr., 1904; sen. ast. judge, Mar., 1905; ch. judge, Zanzibar, 20th Sept., 1914; mem., of ct. of appl. for Eastern Africa, 1905-1910, and from 1914 upon transfer of Zanzibar to C.O.; judge, sup. ct. of H.H. Sultan of Zanzibar from 1908; arbitrator in dispute between Zanzibar and E.A.P. govts. as to H.H. mainland properties, 1911; recd. thanks of S. of S. for conversion of applied Indian Acts into Zanzibar Decrees, 1917; judge prize et. Zanzibar from 1914; passed govt. exam. in Hindustani, 1903, and in Swahili, 1904; exam. in Swahili to the Zanzibar Govt.; joint edr., Zanzibar Law Repta., 1868-1918; attr.-gen., Sttimta, 1919; ag. col. sec., June, 1920 to May, 1921; ch. just., S. Sttimta, July, 1925; rec., 1933; commr. to Palestine to inquire into Jewish-Arab riots, 1934; edited the laws of the S. Sttimta, 1926; author of "Swahili Translations," 1911.

MURPHY, Hon. Denis, B.A.—B. 1870; Ottawa Univ.; B.A.; 1892; called to the bar, Ottawa; 1896; elec. to provincial lega., British Columbia, 1900; judge of sup. ct., B. Columbia, 1909.

MURPHY, JOHN HOWARD BLACKWOOD.—B. 1895; Schl. of Physic, Trinity Coll., Dublin, 1913; R.A.M.C., Jan., 1915; India Office, Apr., 1919; A.D.C., Jubaland, Dec., 1919; dist. commr., Gosa, 1920; ditto, Choref, 1922; ditto, Ukambani, 1923; resigned, private affairs, Feb., re-apptd., commr., Somaliland, 1927; dist. offr., Kenya, 1930.

MURPHY, JOHN PELLY.—B. 1905; Mt. St. Mary's Coll., Chesterfield, E.I., LL.B., (T.C.D.); solr., high ct. of just., June, 1932; junr. legal offr., Hong Kong, Apr., 1934; ag. dep. regnr., sup. ct., Apr., 1936.

MURPHY, JOSEPH.—B. 1892; ed. Scoil, Sligo; R.L.C., 1913-22; Jamaica counc., Apr., 1922; sub-inspr., Apr., 1926; sec. inspr., Apr., 1931; King's pol. med., 1926.

MURPHY, PHILIP PAINE, B.A., M.B., B.C., B.A.O. (Dublin)—B. 1910; ed. Trinity Coll., Dublin; Royal City of Dublin Hosp.; dist. offr., Somaliland, Jan., 1935.

MURPHY, TIMOTHY.—B. 1882; joined Hong Kong pol., Dec., 1903; passed final exam., Cantonese, 1912; inspr., Aug., 1913; med., 1924; C.D.I., Nov., 1926; ast. sup. ct., July, 1931.

MURPHY, WILLIAM LINDSAY.—B.A., Coll., Dublin; B. 1887; cadet, Ceylon, Nov., 1910; attd. Kandy kach., Dec., 1910; pol. mag., Colombo, Aug., 1911; ag. offic. in govt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, Jan., 1912; ast. to govt., Prov. of Uva, May, 1913; ast. settmtn. offr., July, 1913; ag. ast. govt., Kandy, Feb., 1918; addtl. pol. mag. and mun. mag., Colombo, Apr., 1915; ag. ast. agt., Mullaitivu, Oct., 1915; ditto, Hanwella, Nov., 1917; ditto, Matare, Oct., 1920; dist. judge, Galle, Jan., 1921; ag. ast. agt., Kegalla, May, 1921; ast. govt. agt., Sept., 1922; ast. govt. ast., Trincomalee, 1923; temp. employed, C.O., 1926; ast. col. sec., Jan., 1927; 2nd ast. col. sec., leg. coun., Feb., 1927; prtn. ast. col. clk., exec. coun., May, 1928; comptr., 1931; chmn., munie. coun. and mayor, Mar., 1932.

MURRAY, ALEXANDER ROSS, A.B.—B. 1896; ast. engrnr., P.W.D., F.W.D.K., 1923; ast. engrnr., hydrds., P.W.D.K., 1928; ast. drnge. and irrig. engrnr., drnge. and irrig. engrnr., Selangor, 1930; ast. drnge. and irrig. engrnr., Nov., 1935.

MURRAY, ARTHUR EVELYN FRANCIS (Oxon.), Barrister.—B. 1888; ed. and Exeter Coll., Oxford; ast. dist. judge, Nigeria, 1912; cls. I, grade I, admin., 1928; sec. to comm. of inquiry into mining in S.E. Provs., 1930; ag. sec. for 1930; staff grade, 1936.

MURRAY, FREDERICK.—B. 1879; town Acad., Wick, Scotland; C. 1897; prov. acct., O.F.S., Jun., Transvaal, Feb., 1935.
MURRAY, Hon. Sir George John Robert, C.M.G. (1917), B.A., LL.M.—B. 1863; judge sup. ct., S. Australia, 1912; chief just., Jan., 1916; and lieutenant-gov., Apr., 1916.

MURRAY, Sir J. H. P., K.C.M.G. (1925), M.G. (1914).—M.A., Oxon.; ed. at Sydney Univ.; schol. and won Knox prize, Fairfax prize, Univ. prize, and John West medal; went to Brighton Coll., Germany, and Univ. Coll., London; entd. Oxford Univ. and gained foundation scholarship to Magdalen Coll., 1880; 1st class mods., 1882; 1st cl. Lit. Hum., 1884; B.A., 1885; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1886; practised as a barrister in Australia until appointed crown prosecutor, N.S. Wales; acted as ass't. at judge on several occasions; commanded N.S.W. Irish Lancers, 1898; served in S. African war, 1900-1901; rec'd. comm. of major in Imperial army in recognition of his services, 1902; chief official off. and mem. of exec. and legis. councils, Cape, Sept., 1904; ag. administrator, 8th Apr., 1907; and lieutenant-gov., in addition to duties of judge, 1908.

MURRAY, Menzies.—B. 1890; ed. Stellenbosch and Trinity Coll., Dublin; B.A. (hons.); LL.B. (T.C.D.), 1914; L.B. (S.A.), 1920; war serv., 1914-19; capt., T.W. Fus., M.C.; advoc., 1921; ch. clk., patent office, Union of S. Africa, Jan., 1930; register patents and registers, companies, June 1932.

MURRAY, Robert Everitt King.—B. 1902; llk., grade II, Basutoland, 1924; sub-instr., Basutoland mounted pol., 1930.

MURTLAND, Charles Campbell.—B. 1884; d. Harrogate, York and Dublin; sub-instr. of police, B. Guiana, 1908; dist.-instr., 1912; ag. county instr., 1910-1911, 1914-1916; capt., B. Guiana militia, 1915; county instr., 1920; detective instr., 1927; ag. dep. instr.-gen., various periods, 1928-33.

MYCOCK, Charles.—B. 1890; asst. mast., ducan dept., Hong Kong, Jan., 1915; asst. able censor, 1914-16; on mil'y serv., 1917-19; adm'r. Ellis Kadodoo schl., 1919; do., Yaumati chl., 1928-30 and 1932-34; 2nd mast., Queen's coll., 1930.

MYERS, Rt. Hon. Sir Michael, P.C. (1931), K.C.M.G. (1930), K.C. (1922), LL.B. (1897)—B. 1873; ed. Thorndon schl., Wellington Coll., and Canterbury Univ. Coll. (N.Z.); in legal practice many years; ch. just., N.Z., 1929.

NAIRAC, George Edouard, K.C.—B. 1876; d. R. Coll., Mauritius; called to bar, 1898; ag. dudl. subst. procureur and advoc.-gen., 1903-06; mem. for Port Louis in coun. of govt., 1911-23; nominated mem., 1926; K.C., 1926; procureur and advoc.-gen., July, 1927; mem., exec. coun. and coun. of govt.; ag. col. sec., July, 1928 to Mar., 1929; ag. ch. just., Oct., 1929 to Oct., 1930; ch. judge, 1935; edr. Mauritius Law Repts. since 1906 and of the Law Repts. Digest, 1902-25.

NAISH, Richard Bryant, B.A. (Oxon.), M.R. San. I.—B. 1891; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1914; attached to Galle kach., Dec., 1914; addl. pol. mag., Galle in addn., Apr., 1915; extra office asst. to govt. agt., N. Prov., Oct., 1916; pol. mag., Gampola, Dec., 1918; asst. contr. of estate supplies, May, 1919; office asst. to govt. agt., C. Prov., Feb., 1920; addl. pol. mag., Colombo, Negombo and Avissawella, Sept., 1920; asst. finan. asst. to chm., mun. coun., Colombo, Jan., 1921; pol. mag., Pt. Pedro, Nov., 1921; asst. govt. agt., Batticaloa, Mar., 1923; ditto, Karunegala, Sept., 1925; asst. contr., rev., Mar., 1928; sec., univ. comsn. in addn., July, 1928; addl. pol. mag., Colombo, Sept., 1931; dep. contr., lab., Oct., 1931; attd., atty.-gen.'s dept. for sp. duty, May, 1934.

NANKIVELL, Howard.—B. 1893; ed. Christ's Hosp.; clk., col. secretariat, Jamaica, 1911; asst., 1912; 2nd cls. air mech., R.F.C., 1916; 2nd lieut., R.F.C., 1916; lieut., tech. R.A.F., 1917-1920; 2nd cls. clk., col. secretariat, Jamaica, 1917; 1st ditto, 1920; sec. salaries regrading comsn., 1922; sec., disturbances comsn., 1922; sec. advisory finan. comtee., 1924; sec. civ. serv. comtee., 1925; prin. clk., secretariat, 1925; sec. prelim. W. I. conf., 1926; attd. for temp. duty, C.O., 1926; sec., salaries comsn., Jamaica, 1928; ag. clk., privy coun., 1928; asst. col. sec., Trinidad Apr., 1929; ag. col. sec. on various occasions, 1929-36; dep. col. sec. Jan., 1930; sec., intercol. conference trade relations with Canada, 1930; sec., Trinidad air bd., 1930; ag. gov.'s dep., Jan., 1932 and Aug., 1934; chmn., unemployment bd., 1935; do., nutrition comtee., 1936.

NAPIER, Sir Walter John, K.T. Bach. (1909), D.C.L. (Oxon.).—Barrister-at-law, Lincoln's Inn; atty.-gen., S. Stirlings., 1907-1909; mem., W. African lands comtee., 1912.

NASH, Herbert Frederick William.—B. 1901; entered C.O., 26th Nov., 1917; apptd., after compet. exam., asst. clk. and assigned to C.O., 29th Dec., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920; higher cler. offr., 17th Sept., 1929.

NASH, Hon. Walter.—B. 1882; ed. St. John's Sch.; mem., N.Z. H. of R. since 1929; min. of finance, min. of cust., min. of stamp duties, 1935, also min. of marketing, 1936; mem., national induc. conf., 1927; has represented N.Z. at various conf., overseas, including 2nd internat. lab. conf., Geneva, 1920, conf. of inst., of Pacific relations, 1927 and 1933, and conf. of Br. commonwealth relations, 1933.

NASH, Walter.—B. 1890; ed. King's Coll., London; conf. clk. to gov.-gen., Nigeria, July, 1913; adm'v. offr., 1918; res., 1932.

NASON, Wilfred Paul.—B. 1894; ed. Christ's Hosp.; served with forces, France and Russia, 1915-19; asst. audr., Tanganyika Territory; do., Nigeria, 1928; audr., Leeward Is., 1932; audr., Trinidad, 1935.

NATHAN, Lt.-Col. Sir Matthew, G.C.M.G. (1908), K.C.M.G. (1902), C.M.G. (1899).—B. 1862; entd. R.E., 1880; capt., 1889; maj., 1898; li.-col., 1907; served in Nile expedit., 1885; Lushai expedit. (medal with clasp), 1889; sec. col. def. comtee., 1890; adminstr. gov. of S. Leone in 1899; gov., Gold Coast, Oct., 1900; gov., Hong Kong, 21st Sept., 1903; gov., Natal, 1st May, 1907; sec. to G.P.O., London, 1910; chrmn. of bd. of inland revenue, 1911; under sec. to lord-lieut. of Ireland, 1914; permanent sec. to ministry of pensions, 1916; gov., Queensland, 1920-25.

NATTRASS, Roland Marshall, B.Sc. (Agr.), Lond., Ph.D., Lond., D.I.C., Dip. Agr., Wye.—B.1895; ed. Nottingham High Schl.; asst. to cotton specialist, Tanganyika Territory, 1922; advisory mycologist, Western Prov.; Bristol Univ., Long Ashton Research Statn., 1924; senr. mycologist, miny. of agr., Egypt, 1928; mycologist (now plant pathologist), Cyprus, 1931.

NATTRISS, Ernest Alfred, O.B.E. (1934).—B. 1882; ent. C.A. shipping agents, 1898; apptd. to C.A. office, 1912; dep. head, shipping dept., 1922; apptd. shipping offr. to the "Discovery Committee," 1927; head, shipping dept., 1933; do., gen. stores dept., 1935.
NAVARATNAM, SARAVANAMUTTU SAMUEL, B.Sc. (Lond.)—B. 1894; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1921; attd., Matara Kach., Dec., 1921; ditto, Ratnapura Kach., May, 1922; extra office ast. to gvt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, Sept., 1923; pol. mag., Matale, May, 1924; ditto, Chilaw, Feb., 1926; ast. comsrr., excise, Aug., 1927; dist. judge, Kegalle, Mar., 1930; ast. attlmt. offr., July, 1931; sec. to min. of lab., industry and commerce, Oct., 1931; dep. contr., lab., Aug., 1933; ast. land comsrr., Dec., 1933; ast. settlmt. offr., June, 1934.

NEAVE, JOHN RICHARD, M.C.—B. 1893; ed. King's Coll., Lond.; cadet, S.S., Oct., 1919; attd., res. office, Malacca, Nov., 1919; ast. advr., Kota Tinggi, Feb., 1925; res., Labuan, Dec., 1927; offr., cls. III, Jan., 1930; ag. comsrr., lands, Trengganu, July, 1931; 2nd astt. sec. (A), S.S., Dec., 1932; ag. astt. treas. and collr., land rev., Malacca, Aug., 1933; offr. cls. II, Jan., 1935.

NEFF, ERROLL AUBREY, M.D., L.C.P. & S. (Alberta), D.P.H.—B. 1887; ed. High Schl., Ingersoll, Ont.; Toronto Univ. and Western Univ.; on war serv. with rank of major, 1914-19; dist. med. offr., Fiji, and med. supt., Cent. Leper Hosp., Makogai, Fiji, 1921; two Rockefeller foundation fellowships, 1926 and 1931; rep. S. Pacific cols. at Internat. Leprosy Confce., Manila, 1931; senr. med. offr., (now dir., med. services), Cyprus, Nov., 1934.

NEILL, J. H.—Med. offr., E. Africa Prot., Mar., 1919; ditto, Uganda, July, 1920.

NEIL, WILLIAM HARDLEY EDWIN, F.R.G.S.—B. 1892; ed. Cathedral Sch., Winchester, Taunton's, Southampton and Hartley Univ. Coll., Extn., Southampton; war ser., Sept., 1914-Sept., 1919; survey probtrn., F.M.S., Nov., 1920; astt. supt., trig. surveys, Dec., 1923; ditto, topo. br., Dec., 1925; ditto, rev. surveys, Pahang, Jan., 1931; astt. supt., surveys, N. Kedah, Aug., 1932; senr. astt. supt., surveys, Malaya, 1935.

NEILL, JAMES SCOTT, B.A., Barrister-at-Law.—B. 1889; ed. Trinity Coll., Dublin; clas. schol., 1911; 1st sen. mod. hist. and pol. sci., 1912; Victoria prizeman, Kings Inns., Dublin; cadet, Fiji, 1914; clk., leg. and exec. coun., Oct., 1915; dist. comsrr., 1916; regr. sup. ct. and off. recr., 1922; ag. atty. gen. and mem. exec. and leg. coun., July, 1922 to July, 1923; ag. prin. astt. col. sec. and ast. gen., imigr., Jan., 1924 and Sept., 1924; mem., bd. examrs. Fijian language and ag. editor, Indian newspaper "Radjut"; seconded sp. duty under Tongan govt. and apptd. mem., privy coun. of Tonga, Aug.-Sept., 1924; comsrr. of assize, circuit ct., June, 1925; ct. of review, income tax, Nov., 1925; Br. agt. and cons. gen., Tonga, Jan., 1927; is also a dep. comsrr. for W. Pacific and a judl. comsrr. for matrimonial causes; seconded for sp. duty, Ocean Is., Dec., 1930 to Mar., 1931.

NEILSON, HARRY ROSS, M.B., Ch.B., D.P.H.—B. 1879; ed. Bedford Mod. Sch. and Aberdeen Univ.; med. offr., Uganda, 1912; temp. capt., Uganda med. staff, 1914; health offr., 1921; senr. do., 1924; ag. D.D.S.S. for various periods, 1926-32.

NEILSON, MAJOR JOHN BARRIE, M.C. and 2 Bars, M.A. (Oxon.), M.A. (Glas.).—B. 1896; ast. insur. sbls., Perak, July, 1921; ast. mast. gov't. Eng. schl., Alor Star, Aug., 1921; ar. ast. mast., Raffles Inst., Apr., 1926; inspr., schls., N. Sembilan, Sept., 1928; do., Pahang, Dec., 1930 and Jan., 1935; ag. headmr., Penang Free Schl., June, 1935.

NEISH, DONALD GORDON.—B. 1906; Bedford Schl.; 2nd lt., Jamaica loco, 1928; lt., 1930; machine gun offr., 1931-33; inspr., Jamaica constab., 1933; 3rd cl. ast., 1936.

NETTTELTON, GERALD ENRAGHT.—Ch. comsrr.'s office, 1914; sub-inspr., Bechuanaland Prot., pol., 1917; sp. J.R., 1917; ast. nat. tr. 1920; passed 1st gr. Seeawa exam., 1920; civ. serv. lower law exam., 1922; ag. nat. tr. res. mag. and hom. insp. Bech. Prot., 1924.

NEWBOLT, CAPT. A. F.—B. 1893; Chester and New Coll., Oxford; B.A.; civ. serv., Oxfordshire Light Infy., Aug., 1914; May, 1919; served in Flanders, wounded, 1915; capt., 1915; adjt., 1919; ast. sec. (appts.) to S. of S., Lord Milner, 1919; Mr. Winston Churchill, Feb., 1921; Lord of Devonshire, Oct., 1922; Mr. J. H. P., Jan., 1924; Mr. L. C. M. S. Amery, Nov., 1924; Lord Passfield, June, 1929; prim., Ist, 1930.

NEWBOULT, ALEXANDER THOMAS, M.B. 1896; ed. Kingswood and Exeter Col., Oxford; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1920; ast. secr., Dec., 1920; offr., ola V, Aug., 1921; offr., Jelebu, Nov., 1925; offr., cl. IV, 1927; sec. to res., N. Sembilan, Dec., 1927; cls. III, Aug., 1932; ag. comsrr., lands and Trengganu, Oct., 1933.

NEWHOUSE, EDWARD, P.A.S.I.—B. 1896; ed. Friend's Sch., Lancaster; ast. waterwks., Hong Kong, 1912; eng. engr., 1912; do., roads, 1927; 2nd, 1932; eng., waterwks., 1932; ag. A.D.P.W., 1932; ast. D.P.W., 1932.

NEWILL, COMM. JOSEPH BERNARD, D.R.N. (ret.)—B. 1887; harbmr., Malaca, dep. harbmr., Hong Kong, 1926.

NEWMAN, WILLIAM AUGUSTIN, M.B., B.S., 1873; ed. Sydney High Schl.; ent. New Wales pub. serv., 1891; served with Aust. forces, S. African war (Queen's med.); 5th on staff of first prime min. of C'wealth of Jan., 1901; senr. clk., dept. external affr., 1901; C'wealth electoral admnstr., 1901; C'wealth electoral offr. for Victoria, 1909; clk., home affr., 1909; offr. sec. to g. c. of A., and sec. to fedrl. exec. coun., 1916; royal coms. on navy and defence 1916; ch. clk., Australian defence dept. admstr., Island of Nauru, 1927.

NEWNHAM, HUBERT ERNEST.—B. St. John's Coll., Oxford (M.A.); cadet, civ. ser., Nov., 1909; office ast. to Uva, Nov., 1911; pol. mag., Matale, 1913; landing survr., cust., Oct., 1913; ag. requests, Colombo, May, 1920; chmn. munie. coun., Aug., 1924; comsrr., local govt. and govt. bd., and sec. to min. for loca., July, 1931; comsrr. for relief of dis., 1935.

NEWSAM, NEVILLE.—B. 1898; ed. Coll., Barbados; 2nd ast. analyst, 1922; 1st ast. analyst, 1933; ag. gc., 1936.

NEWTON, ALEXANDER STANLEY, M.A. (Liv.), R.A.M.C.—B. 1896; mily. dental surg., Tanganyika Territory.

NEWTON, SIR FRANCIS JAMES (1919). C.M.G. (1892), C.V.O. (1919), ed. at Rugby and Univ. Coll., Oxford; M.A., 1890; barrister, Inner Temp.
Hampshire regt., and extra A.D.C. to Sir
Robinson, gov. Cape, 1881; priv. sec.
Sir Thomas Scanlen, prime minister of
1883; and to Sir H. Robinson, 1884-
sec. to Mauritius roy. comm., 1886; ag.
tr. and ch. mag., Br. Bechuanaland, 1888;
sec. and rec-gen., 1889; ag. admstr. and
mag., 1892; sec. commr., Bechuanaland
territory, Dec., 1895-7; col. sec., Br.
Zamora, 1898; ditto, Barbados, 1901; treas.,
hodessa, 1903; ret., 1919; col. sec., 1st S.
lesian ministry, 1st Oct., 1923; high commr.
Rhodesia in London : ret., 1930.

SWTON, ISAAC, F.R.C.S., L.R.C.P.—B.
olin, ast., Charing Cross hosp., 1924; 2nd
off. at port, Hong Kong, 1925; visiting med.
Kwong Wah hosp., 1926; med. offr. in ch.
loin hosp., 1927; M.O.in-ch., govt., civ.
1930; in ch. Univ. surg. clinic in addn.,
med. offr. in ch., Victoria Hosp., 1932;
off. in ch., govt. civ. mental and Tsan-Yuk
a., 1935; do., surg. clinic, Mar., 1936.
